title: Chemistry-resolved disagreement between Materials Project-compatible PBE(+U) and r2SCAN stability verdicts in the GNoME materials database
comment: 40 pages, 3 figures, 18 tables. Code, pre-committed decision rules and full reproduction pipeline: https://github.com/FOUNDERACCRETION/gnome-audit
summary:
GNoME's stability labels rest on a Materials Project-compatible GGA/GGA+U workflow. Its authors report that 84% of discovered binaries and ternaries retain a negative decomposition energy under r2SCAN and 86.8% of tested quaternaries remain stable on the r2SCAN hull. We resolve that aggregate by chemistry over the 139,541 GNoME materials released with r2SCAN recomputations, a subset the dataset authors selected rather than sampled, using cluster bootstrap intervals over 8,429 structural-prototype proxy clusters.
  The aggregate conceals a 26.7-point spread at fixed element count, from 4.0% [3.3, 4.7] for plain quaternary intermetallics (no lanthanide, no 3d metal) to 30.7% [27.7, 33.8] for lanthanide-free 3d-containing quaternary oxides, a pair identified post hoc against a prospectively fixed threshold. Under our reading of the release's "All" reference set the two cells sit at 14.5% and 37.4%, preserving a 22.9-point spread. Presence of a Materials Project Hubbard-U-list element is strongly associated with disagreement, conditional on the other covariates, in a model over all 139,541 materials (cluster-robust odds ratio 3.45 [3.13, 3.80]). Neither selective U application nor hull proximity explains the association away: disagreement stays elevated outside the U-treated regime, and a natural cubic spline in the continuous PBE decomposition energy moves the odds ratio in the 117,018-material model only from 3.53 to 3.43 [3.07, 3.83]. For allocating a verification budget, composition supplements hull proximity rather than replacing it: over held-out cluster splits at a 20% budget, the two together surface 45.8% of disagreements against 40.4% for hull distance alone. An exploratory comparison against previously catalogued materials changes direction between populations. We measure disagreement between two workflows, not accuracy.

AI.tldr: 对GNoME发布的139,541个材料按化学组成拆解其GGA/GGA+U与r2SCAN稳定性标签的一致率，发现聚合数字掩盖了26.7个百分点（同元素数下）的化学依赖性差异，且Hubbard-U元素的存在与不一致强相关。
AI.motivation: GNoME作者报告的"84%/86.8%稳定性保留率"是聚合数字，可能掩盖不同化学体系间的巨大差异；作者希望按化学组成解析该聚合量，并检验U处理、凸包距离等因素能否解释不一致。
AI.method: 基于GNoME发布的139,541个带r2SCAN重算的材料（作者选定而非随机抽样），以8,429个结构原型代理簇做簇自助法区间；比较两套工作流的分解能/稳定性判定；用含Hubbard-U元素指示变量的簇稳健logistic模型（全量与117,018子集），并加PBE分解能自然三次样条；在留出簇划分上评估按组成+凸包距离分配20%验证预算的召回。
AI.result: 固定元素数下不一致率跨度26.7点：普通四元金属间化合物仅4.0%[3.3,4.7]，无镧系含3d的四元氧化物达30.7%[27.7,33.8]（按"All"参考集为14.5%与37.4%，跨度22.9点）。含MP Hubbard-U元素与不一致强相关，簇稳健OR=3.45[3.13,3.80]；样条校正后仅降至3.43[3.07,3.83]。20%预算下组成+凸包距离捕获45.8%不一致，凸包距离单独为40.4%。
AI.conclusion: 聚合稳定性统计需按化学体系细分解读；U相关体系是验证重点。组成信息作为凸包距离的补充而非替代。该研究衡量的是两套计算工作流间的不一致，而非模型准确率。

title: On the Doppler Effect in Static Materials: Vortices and Black, White and Worm-Hole Like Wave Trajectories
summary: We demonstrate the Doppler effect in a static material. The effect is achieved with a network of thin waveguides whose lengths depend on the direction of travel, chosen to simulate the compression and expansion of the wave experienced by a source travelling with velocity $v$. Each edge of length $\ell$ becomes a pair of waveguides of lengths $\ell/(1\mp v/c)$, one for each direction of travel. On a lattice this gives the field pattern of a moving source. To demonstrate the effect, we design a vortex, an analogue black hole and wormhole.

AI.tldr: 在静态超材料波导网络中，通过让不同传输方向的波导长度按多普勒因子 \ell/(1∓v/c) 不对称设计，模拟运动源产生的波场，并以此构造了涡旋、类比黑洞与虫洞。
AI.motivation: 多普勒效应通常需要源与观察者之间存在相对运动，作者希望在没有真实运动、完全静态的材料中复现运动源（速度 v）引起的波的压缩/膨胀效果，从而把"运动"转化为可由几何设计控制的静态结构。
AI.method: 用网络形式的细波导实现：每条长度为 \ell 的边替换为一对沿相反传输方向长度分别为 \ell/(1−v/c) 与 \ell/(1+v/c) 的波导；在格点上铺设此非对称网络后，等效能给出以速度 v 运动的源的场图样。再基于该设计构造三种示例器件：涡旋、类比黑洞和虫洞。
AI.result: 在静态波导晶格中成功再现了运动源的多普勒场图样，并演示了涡旋、类比黑洞与虫洞三种结构（摘要未给出定量测量或实验/数值验证细节）。
AI.conclusion: 多普勒效应可由纯几何的、方向相关的波导长度不对称性在静态材料中"人工合成"，为在静态平台上模拟相对论/运动源现象（包括弯曲时空类比）提供了简洁的设计原理。

title: The Ising lattice gas and the surface diffusion of CO on Cu(001) at finite coverage
summary: The memory equation of the coherent intermediate scattering function (ISF), derived previously for lattice gases, is applied to the Ising lattice gas under Kawasaki dynamics. The ISF follows the decay of a density wave of adparticles, a superposition of exponential relaxation modes: the decay starts at a rate fixed by a sum rule and is then slowed by a memory. The static structure factor and the effective hop rate are obtained in closed form, exactly along a one-dimensional channel; with the sum rule they give a single exponential, a lower bound on the ISF. Exact relaxation spectra show that this single exponential, built from equilibrium quantities alone, reproduces the correlation time only at weak coupling; only there can a measured dephasing rate be read through the statics. For strong attraction the slow dissolution of clusters lengthens the correlation time up to ninefold, whereas a repulsive layer relaxes nearly as a single mode at its structure peak. The dephasing rate, fitted over a time window where it is nearly constant, approaches the slowest relaxation rate, not the initial one; the sum rule reaches the data only through the area beneath the normalized decay, which defines the correlation time. For CO/Cu(001), the lattice gas reproduces the dephasing rates measured along two crystal directions and requires a nearest-neighbour repulsion of at least $35$--$50$~meV, whatever the jump rates; the measured rate is then close to the inverse correlation time, and the memory is predicted to grow with coverage.

AI.tldr: 将晶格气体ISF记忆方程用于Kawasaki动力学下的Ising晶格气体，得到闭式静态结构因子与有效跳跃率，揭示单指数下界仅弱耦合时成立，并在CO/Cu(001)中拟合出≥35-50 meV的近邻排斥。
AI.motivation: 需要理清记忆效应对相干中间散射函数衰减的影响，并检验能否仅凭静态（平衡）量读出测量的退相位速率，从而对实验体系（CO/Cu(001)）给出可验证的相互作用参数。
AI.method: 把先前针对晶格气体推导的ISF记忆方程应用于Kawasaki动力学下的Ising晶格气体；在一维通道上精确求解静态结构因子与有效跳跃率，并结合求和规则构造单指数下界，与精确弛豫谱对比；最后用CO/Cu(001)两个晶向的退相位数据拟合近邻排斥。
AI.result: 单指数下界（仅由平衡量构成）只在弱耦合下能重现关联时间，此时测得的退相位速率才可由静态量读出；强吸引下团簇缓慢溶解使关联时间延长最多约九倍，而排斥层在其结构峰附近近乎单模弛豫；拟合窗口内的退相位速率趋近最慢弛豫速率而非初始速率，求和规则只通过归一化衰减下的面积（即关联时间）与数据对应；CO/Cu(001)数据要求最近邻排斥至少35–50 meV（与跳跃率无关），且测量速率接近关联时间倒数，并预测记忆效应随覆盖度增大。
AI.conclusion: 记忆效应使ISF的初始速率不能直接作为测得速率；静态量只在弱耦合下能预测动力学，强关联时关联时间由慢模决定。对于CO/Cu(001)，晶格气体模型配合较强最近邻排斥可同时解释两个方向的数据，并给出记忆随覆盖度增长的预测。

title: Cooperation of itinerant and localized physics in the magnetic phase diagram of 214 Ruddlesden-Popper iridates
summary: The $5d^5$ Ruddlesden-Popper iridates Sr$_2$IrO$_4$ and Ba$_2$IrO$_4$ have attracted considerable attention as spin-orbit entangled analogues of the cuprates, yet the origin of their antiferromagnetic insulating state, of Slater or of Mott-Heisenberg type, remains debated. We find that both materials sit in an intermediate regime in which itinerant and localized electrons cooperate in stabilizing the antiferromagnetic order, with Ba$_2$IrO$_4$ slightly more correlated than Sr$_2$IrO$_4$. We obtain this by computing, within dynamical mean-field theory, the interaction-temperature phase diagram of a realistic three-orbital $t_{2g}$ Hubbard model with spin-orbit coupling. Our study shows that neither the behavior of the gap across the Néel temperature nor the spin-polaron features of the spectral function unambiguously identify the cooperative regime, whereas the two-peak structure of the optical conductivity is reproduced only there and therefore constitutes a reliable fingerprint. By placing both compounds in a common phase diagram, our results reconcile seemingly contradictory experimental and theoretical reports, and provide a unified framework for future studies of the 214 iridates and of other spin-orbit coupled correlated materials.

AI.tldr: 在DMFT框架下计算真实三轨道t2g Hubbard模型（含自旋轨道耦合）的相互作用-温度相图，将Sr2IrO4与Ba2IrO4定位在巡游与局域电子协同稳定反铁磁序的中间区域，Ba2IrO4关联更强。
AI.motivation: 5d5 Ruddlesden-Popper铱氧化物Sr2IrO4和Ba2IrO4被视为铜氧化物的自旋轨道纠缠类比物，但其反铁磁绝缘态的起源（Slater型还是Mott-Heisenberg型）长期存在争议。
AI.method: 采用动力学平均场理论（DMFT），对含自旋轨道耦合的真实三轨道t2g Hubbard模型计算相互作用-温度相图，并考察能隙随奈尔温度的行为、谱函数中的自旋极化子特征以及光电导的双峰结构。
AI.result: 两种材料均处于巡游与局域电子协同的中间区域，Ba2IrO4比Sr2IrO4关联略强；能隙在奈尔温度附近的行为与谱函数自旋极化子特征均无法唯一判别协同区域，而光电导的双峰结构仅在该区域出现，可作为可靠判据。
AI.conclusion: 将两种化合物置于统一相图中，调和了看似矛盾的实验与理论报道，为214铱氧化物及其他自旋轨道耦合关联材料的研究提供了统一框架。

title: Orbital Hall response of spin-1 fermions with a curved central band
summary: We investigate the orbital Hall effect in a three-band system described by a low-energy Hamiltonian containing both linear and quadratic momentum-dependent contributions. The linear term lifts the degeneracy between the dispersive bands, providing a minimal setting to study orbital transport in a multiband system with a curved central band. Within a quantum kinetic approach, we derive the intrinsic orbital Hall response and analyze its microscopic origin in terms of interband coherence induced by an external electric field. We show that the orbital Hall conductivity arises from the interplay between the momentum-dependent orbital character of the eigenstates and transitions between different bands. The spin-1 structure provides a particularly transparent platform in which the contributions associated with different interband channels can be identified separately. We further show that the differential orbital Hall response provides a direct probe of the low-energy structure, exhibiting distinct scaling singularities associated with the linear and quadratic bands, respectively, while remaining independent of the ultraviolet cutoff. Our results establish a connection between the multiband quantum geometry of spin-1 fermions and their transverse orbital response, and provide a simple framework for investigating orbital transport beyond two-band models.

AI.tldr: 研究含线性与二次动量项的三带（spin-1）低能模型中的轨道霍尔效应，用量子动理学方法导出本征轨道霍尔响应，并揭示其由能带轨道性质与带间跃迁的协同决定。
AI.motivation: 现有多带轨道输运研究多局限于两带模型，缺乏对带间相干与轨道几何如何共同产生横向轨道响应的微观理解，需要一个能分离不同带间通道的最小模型。
AI.method: 构建含线性与二次动量项的三带低能哈密顿量（线性项解除色散带简并），在量子动理学框架下计算由外电场诱导的带间相干所贡献的本征轨道霍尔电导，并按带间通道分解分析其微观来源。
AI.result: 轨道霍尔电导源于本征态动量依赖轨道性质与带间跃迁的耦合；spin-1结构使各带间通道贡献可单独识别；微分轨道霍尔响应呈现与线性带、二次带相关的不同标度奇异性，且与紫外截断无关。
AI.conclusion: 建立了spin-1费米子多带量子几何与其横向轨道响应之间的联系，提供了超越两带模型研究轨道输运的简洁框架。

title: Evolution of microstructure and crystallographic texture in a novel Zr-4Nb-2Al alloy during hot rotary swaging
comment: 25 pages, 15 figures; submitted to Journal of Alloys and Compounds
summary: A multi-step induction-assisted hot rotary swaging route was developed for the novel dual-phase Zr-4Nb-2Al alloy to investigate the evolution of microstructure, crystallographic texture, and mechanical properties during sequential deformation. Phase-transformation temperatures determined by electrical resistivity measurements were used to select processing conditions in the single-phase $β$ field at 880°C and the $α+β$ field at 780°C. Induction heating with thermographic temperature control enabled reduction of the initial 12 mm rod to 6.3 mm, corresponding to a total area reduction of 72%. Swaging in the $β$ field refined millimetre-sized prior-$β$ grains to approximately 100 $μ$m, while subsequent cooling produced a fine lamellar $α+β$ microstructure. Further deformation in the $α+β$ field disrupted the lamellar structure, promoted globularisation and recrystallisation of the $α$ phase, and refined the $β$ phase. The microstructural evolution was accompanied by a pronounced $\langle 11\bar{2}0\rangle_α\parallel\mathrm{SD}$ fibre texture in the $α$ phase, whereas the $β$ phase exhibited predominantly $\langle 110\rangle_β\parallel\mathrm{SD}$ together with a $\langle 111\rangle_β\parallel\mathrm{SD}$ component. The phase constitution remained comparatively stable, with approximately 12-15 wt.% retained $β$ throughout processing. Subsequent $α+β$ swaging decreased the compressive yield strength from 1103 to 839 MPa while increasing plastic deformability, with a maximum fracture strain of 32%. Radial hardness heterogeneity was progressively eliminated. These results demonstrate that induction-assisted rotary swaging in selected phase fields provides an effective route for tailoring microstructure, texture, and mechanical response in dual-phase zirconium alloys.

AI.tldr: 采用多步感应加热旋转锻造工艺对新型双相Zr-4Nb-2Al合金在β单相区与α+β两相区连续变形，系统研究了组织、织构与力学性能演化，最终获得72%减面率、晶粒细化与32%最大断裂应变的良好强塑性匹配。
AI.motivation: 双相锆合金（Zr-4Nb-2Al）的组织、织构与力学性能难以通过常规工艺协同调控，亟需一条可在选定相区连续变形、实现晶粒细化与织构调控的热加工路线。
AI.method: 先用电学电阻率法测定相变温度，据此选定880°C β单相区与780°C α+β两相区；采用带热像仪控温的感应加热多步旋转锻造，将12 mm棒材锻至6.3 mm（总减面率72%）；随后利用显微组织表征、织构（纤维织构）分析与压缩力学测试及径向硬度测试，追踪各道次的组织与性能演变。
AI.result: β区锻造将毫米级原始β晶粒细化至约100 μm，冷却后形成细层片状α+β组织；α+β区变形打碎层片、促使α相球化与再结晶并细化β相。α相形成强⟨112̄0⟩α∥SD纤维织构，β相以⟨110⟩β∥SD为主并含⟨111⟩β∥SD组分；保留β相稳定在约12–15 wt.%。后续α+β锻造使压缩屈服强度由1103 MPa降至839 MPa，塑性提高，最大断裂应变32%，径向硬度不均匀性逐步消除。
AI.conclusion: 在选定相区实施感应加热旋转锻造，可有效调控双相锆合金的显微组织、织构与力学响应，是一条兼具晶粒细化、织构定制与强度—塑性平衡潜力的热机械加工路线。

title: Winding-Controlled Topological Descendants of Antialtermagnets
summary: Odd-parity spin splitting constrains magnetic band crossings but does not determine their topological descendants. We show that the Chern contribution of an isolated inverted sector is controlled by the phase winding of its transverse mass pair: when the masses and tangential velocities reverse together, contributions from successive Dirac points add rather than cancel. This distinguishes topological winding from the polynomial degree labeling the magnetic parent. For specified complementary masses, periodic tetragonal $h$- and hexagonal $j$-wave models host eight and twelve same-chirality Weyl points on a momentum plane, with gapped-slice Chern numbers $|C|=4$ and $6$, respectively. A microscopic four-band $p$-wave model identifies an antiunitary obstruction to first-order transverse masses and demonstrates a symmetry-broken $C=1$ phase at quarter filling. First-principles calculations for the proposed coplanar spin-vortex texture of LaMnAu$_5$ reveal the $h$-wave nodal pattern, its anisotropic spin--orbit reconstruction, and a mirror-channel spectral response that reverses under opposite spin rotations. Together, these results distinguish the symmetry of an odd-parity magnetic parent from the mass structure controlling the topology of its descendants.

AI.tldr: 该文指出奇宇称自旋劈裂只约束磁性能带交叉，并不决定其拓扑后代；Chern贡献由横质量对的相位缠绕控制，并给出h波/j波模型、p波微观模型以及LaMnAu5第一性原理的三方面证据。
AI.motivation: 以往把奇宇称自旋劈裂（多项式阶数）当作拓扑分类标签，但同一磁母态的退化点可产生不同拓扑后代，二者关系不清。
AI.method: 引入"横向质量对相位缠绕"判据：当质量与切向速度同时反号时，相邻Dirac点贡献相加而非相消；结合周期四方h波、六角j波模型，四带p波微观模型（证明一阶横质量的反幺正阻碍），并对LaMnAu5共面自旋涡旋结构做第一性原理计算。
AI.result: 指定互补质量下，h波与j波模型分别在同一动量面给出8个和12个同手性Weyl点，切片Chern数为|C|=4和6；p波模型在四分之一填充出现对称破缺的C=1相；LaMnAu5计算显示h波节点图样、各向异性自旋轨道重构以及镜像通道谱响应在相反自旋旋转下反转。
AI.conclusion: 应区分奇宇称磁母态的对称性与控制其后代拓扑的质量结构，相位缠绕而非多项式阶数才是决定Chern贡献的关键。

title: Unified First-Principles Theory of Finite-Wave-Vector Photocurrents in Crystals
summary: Spatially structured light carries independent phase and envelope variations in addition to its polarization and frequency. We develop a first-principles theory of second-order dc photocurrents (especially shift and injection) that resolves how these optical degrees of freedom drive distinct dc responses in crystals. The second-order dc response couples two optical field components at the same frequency but with generally different wave vectors. Expanding the response to first order in these wave vectors identifies two rank-four material tensors: $ξ$, which couples to the optical phase gradient and contains the plane-wave photon-drag limit, and $ζ$, which couples to the intensity gradient and describes a spatially varying dc current. Wannier-interpolated calculations for monolayer GeS show symmetry-allowed finite-wave-vector responses that survive at a centrosymmetric structure where conventional bulk photovoltaic effect vanishes. For a Gaussian beam with a uniform phase gradient, the phase-gradient contribution drives current in the same direction on both sides of the beam center, whereas the intensity-gradient contribution drives currents in opposite directions, showing that distinct photocurrent patterns can be selected through the wavefront and envelope of light. A multipolar analysis further resolves the optical corrections into electric-quadrupole, orbital magnetic-dipole, and band-dispersion contributions. Together, these results show how the spatial structure of light can serve as an independent control variable for nonlinear photocurrent generation and provide a first-principles route to predict this response in real materials.

AI.tldr: 本文建立从第一性原理出发的二阶直流光电流理论，阐明空间结构光（相位梯度与强度梯度）如何驱动晶体中不同的直流响应，识别出两个四阶张量ξ和ζ，并在单层GeS中验证。
AI.motivation: 空间结构光除偏振与频率外还携带独立的相位包络信息，但现有二阶直流光电流（位移电流、注入电流）理论未分辨这些光学自由度如何各自驱动不同的直流响应，缺乏统一的理论框架。
AI.method: 将二阶直流响应视为耦合同频率但波矢不同的两个光场分量，对波矢做一阶展开，导出两个秩四材料张量：ξ（耦合光相位梯度，含平面波光子拖曳极限）与ζ（耦合强度梯度，描述空间变化直流电流）；采用Wannier插值对单层GeS进行计算，并进行多极分析分解为电四极、轨道磁偶极与带色散贡献。
AI.result: 单层GeS显示对称性允许的有限波矢响应，且在传统体光伏效应消失的中心对称结构中依然存在；对高斯光束，相位梯度贡献在光束中心两侧产生同向电流，而强度梯度贡献产生反向电流，表明可通过波前和包络选择不同光电流图案。
AI.conclusion: 光的空间结构可作为非线性光电流产生的独立控制变量，本文提供了在真实材料中预测该响应的第一性原理途径。

title: Chern non-trivial two-dimensional square-net nodal line semimetal
summary: We investigate a two-dimensional $p_xp_y$ square-net tight-binding model with two sublattices and introduce a symmetry-informed, momentum-dependent spin-orbit coupling (SOC) with a finite-range real-space hopping representation. Its two components jointly gap the nodal line, while one breaks time-reversal symmetry, producing a Chern-insulating phase with an occupied band Chern number $C=2$. Nanoribbon calculations reveal edge-localized states traversing this gap, with two net chiral modes per edge. We further show that the conserved spin sectors are unitarily equivalent and therefore have equal Chern numbers, ruling out a nontrivial time-reversal-protected $\mathbb{Z}_2$ phase within this ansatz. Our results establish a phenomenological route to Chern topology in square-net two-dimensional systems and clarify the symmetry constraints governing the accessible insulating phases.

AI.tldr: 在二维 $p_xp_y$ 方网格双亚晶格紧束缚模型中引入动量依赖的对称性导向自旋轨道耦合，可打开节点线并实现占据带陈数 $C=2$ 的陈绝缘相，边缘有两条净手性模式。
AI.motivation: 方网格二维体系的拓扑绝缘相通常受对称性约束；作者希望用现象学方式（对称性导向的 SOC ansatz）在 $p_xp_y$ 模型中打开节点线并明确可达绝缘相的对称性限制。
AI.method: 构建双亚晶格 $p_xp_y$ 方网格紧束缚模型，引入有限程实空间跃迁表示的、动量依赖的 SOC（两个分量联合打开节点线，其中一分量破坏时间反演）；通过纳米带计算和 Chern 数、$\mathbb{Z}_2$ 分析表征能带拓扑。
AI.result: SOC 两分量联合打开节点线，出现陈绝缘相，占据带陈数 $C=2$；纳米带能谱显示边缘局域态穿越带隙，每边两条净手性模式；守恒自旋扇区幺正等价，故陈数相等，排除该 ansatz 下非平庸时间反演保护的 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 相。
AI.conclusion: 给出了方网格二维体系实现陈拓扑（$C=2$）的现象学路径，并厘清了该对称性约束下可实现的绝缘相范围。

title: Exploring Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures for Self-Supervised Representation Learning of Powder X-ray Diffraction Patterns
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Accepted by AAAI 2026 Fall Symposium Series Workshop "Parsimonious Scientific Machine Learning: Accelerating Scientific Discovery with AI under Data and Compute Constraints"
summary: Powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) is the primary high-throughput method for resolving crystal structures, a cornerstone of materials science. As high-throughput synthesis and self-driving laboratories advance, automated XRD pattern analysis has become vital for accelerating materials discovery. However, traditional matrix factorization methods fail when lattice variations cause non-linear peak shifts. At the same time, supervised learning approaches face a combinatorial explosion when handling multi-phase mixtures. To overcome these challenges, we adopt a self-supervised Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) to learn representation embeddings from 1D diffraction patterns. By optimizing a masked self-prediction loss directly within the latent space, the framework captures high-level crystallographic semantics. Downstream evaluations show that lightweight attentive probes trained on frozen JEPA representations achieve space group classification and lattice parameter estimation accuracy close to much larger supervised vision transformers. Furthermore, latent probing reveals that the learned representation space naturally organizes physical transformations, isolating smooth trajectories for peak broadening. Interestingly, decoding along latent paths between single-phase crystal representations yields realistic multi-phase mixture patterns, demonstrating an emergent continuous structure learned without explicit multi-phase supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文采用自监督的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）从一维粉末 XRD 图谱中学习表征，通过潜空间中的掩码自预测损失捕捉晶体学语义，实现接近大型监督 ViT 的空间群分类和晶格参数估计精度。
AI.motivation: 高通量合成与自驱动实验室需要自动化 XRD 分析，但传统矩阵分解方法在晶格变化导致非线性峰移时失效，监督学习在多相混合场景下面临组合爆炸问题。
AI.method: 使用 JEPA 自监督框架对 1D 衍射图谱建模，在潜空间中直接优化掩码自预测损失以学习高层晶体学语义；下游采用轻量级 attentive probe 在冻结表征上进行探针评估，并进行潜空间探测与路径解码分析。
AI.result: 轻量探针在空间群分类与晶格参数估计上接近更大的监督视觉 Transformer；潜空间自然组织物理变换，峰展宽呈现平滑轨迹；单相晶体表征之间的潜路径解码可生成真实的多相混合图谱。
AI.conclusion: JEPA 自监督表征无需多相监督即可涌现连续结构，为 XRD 自动化分析提供高效、可扩展的替代方案。

title: Optimal Search Strategies under Finite Resource Constraints
summary: Improving target search is a challenge faced by many natural and artificial agents, often requiring the use of energetic or material resources. These inputs may be supplied by an external controller or generated by the searcher itself, for example, through the deposition of cues along its trajectory. Although such resources are commonly modeled as costly but available without an explicit limit, in practice, they can often only be produced in finite amounts. Here, we go beyond the assumption of an unlimited supply of resources by investigating searches in which a finite resource budget must be allocated throughout the search process. To investigate this problem, we equip a one-dimensional diffusive searcher with three types of resources: an external force, a supply of partially reflecting flags, and auto-chemotactic cues. We derive exact optimal resource-allocation protocols for informed search processes in which the agent has continuous access to its past and current positions, which we find to always require resource allocation to be spatially concentrated. We then determine the corresponding protocols for blind searchers and show that resource usage must be more evenly distributed. Non-Markovian cues that generate environmental memory are found to substantially improve search performance when the agent has access to positional information, even under finite-resource constraints. In contrast, their benefits are considerably more limited for blind search, particularly when the cues provide no directional information.

AI.tldr: 研究有限资源预算下的一维扩散搜索者，比较外部力、部分反射旗帜与自趋化线索三类资源的精确最优分配协议。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索模型通常把资源视为有代价但数量无限，而实际中资源往往只能有限产生，因此需要研究有限预算在整个搜索过程中的最优分配问题。
AI.method: 给一维扩散搜索者配备三种有限资源（外部力、部分反射旗帜、自趋化线索），分别针对可获知位置信息的有信息搜索者与盲搜索者推导精确最优资源分配协议。
AI.result: 有信息搜索的最优协议总是要求资源在空间上集中投放；盲搜索则需要更均匀地分配资源。产生环境记忆的非马尔可夫线索在有位置信息时能显著提升性能，而对盲搜索（尤其无线索方向信息时）收益有限。
AI.conclusion: 有限资源约束下，最优分配策略取决于搜索者是否具备位置信息；非马尔可夫环境记忆对知情搜索价值大，对盲搜索价值小。

title: OpenFerro: a unified framework for mesoscale ferroic dynamics and enhanced sampling
summary: Modeling ferroic materials requires connecting microscopic fluctuations to collective dynamics over mesoscales. We introduce OpenFerro, a unified lattice-field dynamics framework that combines flexible Hamiltonians, automatic differentiation, parallel execution, and enhanced sampling. The same framework can simulate ferroelectric domain motion, magnetic disordering, and coupled spin-lattice thermodynamics. On four graphics processors, a bulk BaTiO$_3$ benchmark with long-range dipolar interaction reaches $840^3$ unit cells, representing 3 billion atoms through the retained lattice variables. We simulate polarization textures in a PbTiO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ superlattice spanning $0.8~μ\mathrm{m}$ laterally and a BaTiO$_3$ nanoparticle 200~nm in diameter, retaining unit-cell resolution. We also demonstrate enhanced-sampling simulations that reconstruct the polarization free-energy surface of bulk BaTiO$_3$ without a prescribed polynomial form. With moderate computational resources, OpenFerro achieves atomistic-resolution simulations at mesoscopic scales traditionally studied with continuum models.

AI.tldr: OpenFerro 是一个统一的晶格-场动力学框架，结合灵活哈密顿量、自动微分、并行计算与增强采样，实现了介观尺度上原子分辨率的铁性材料模拟。
AI.motivation: 铁性材料研究需要在介观尺度上把微观涨落与集体动力学联系起来，而传统上原子尺度方法与连续介质模型之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出 OpenFerro 框架：整合灵活可定制的哈密顿量、自动微分、并行执行与增强采样；同一框架可模拟铁电畴运动、磁无序化以及自旋-晶格耦合热力学。
AI.result: 四块 GPU 上，含长程偶极相互作用的 BaTiO3 体相基准达到 840^3 个晶胞（约30亿原子）；模拟了横向 0.8 μm 的 PbTiO3/SrTiO3 超晶格极化织构和直径 200 nm 的 BaTiO3 纳米颗粒，均保持晶胞分辨率；并通过增强采样重建了 BaTiO3 体相的极化自由能面，无需预设多项式形式。
AI.conclusion: 借助中等计算资源，OpenFerro 即可在传统上用连续介质模型研究的介观尺度上实现原子分辨率的模拟，弥合了原子方法与连续模型之间的尺度鸿沟。

title: Distributional statistics of nonequilibrium
summary: We establish a reference modeling framework for random probability distributions subject to constraints. Generalizing the hyperensemble approach of Crooks, we formulate Jaynesian priors of maximal uncertainty over the unit simplex of categorical distributions. This framework is entirely general, but we primarily investigate models with constraints on physically relevant quantities, namely, average energy and Shannon entropy. A constraint on the exact value of average energy uniquely determines a Boltzmann-Gibbs equilibrium, but also defines a hyperplanar subset of the probability simplex consisting of all distributions with that value of average energy. The associated hyperensemble has a uniform probability density across all such distributions, regardless of distance to equilibrium. Such reference models make predictions of generic nonequilibrium properties such as the mean and modal microstate distributions and the expected free energy of a random distribution, which we examine analytically and via exact sampling algorithms. Moreover, introducing constraints on Shannon entropy permits parametric access to tunably nonequilibrium regimes. The approach follows conventional Jaynesian modeling logic and is compatible with standard Bayesian inference, and reduces to Boltzmann-Gibbs statistics when Shannon entropy is maximized. We examine the physical predictions of this scheme, and demonstrate its wide compatibility with other approaches to nonequilibrium modeling. We illustrate the framework in three scenarios: (i) comparison to superstatistics quasi-equilibrium modeling, (ii) generation of random nonequilibrium steady states, and (iii) Bayesian inference under a prior hyperensemble. We highlight numerous prospects for theoretical extensions and empirical application.

AI.tldr: 该文推广Crooks的hyperensemble方法，在概率单纯形上构建Jaynes式最大不确定性先验，用于受约束的随机概率分布建模，主要研究平均能量与Shannon熵约束下的非平衡性质。
AI.motivation: 传统Boltzmann-Gibbs统计只给出给定平均能量下的唯一平衡分布，缺乏对"具有相同约束值的一整族分布"这一非平衡参考建模的普适框架，作者希望建立与Jaynes逻辑和贝叶斯推断兼容的广义参考模型。
AI.method: 将hyperensemble推广为分类分布单纯形上约束条件下的最大熵先验：平均能量约束确定一个超平面子集，其上赋予均匀概率密度得到hyperensemble；再叠加Shannon熵约束以实现可调的非平衡程度，并结合解析推导与精确采样算法。
AI.result: 平均能量约束下hyperensemble在超平面上均匀分布且与到平衡的距离无关；可解析/采样得到平均与模态微态分布、随机分布期望自由能等非平衡性质；熵约束提供可调非平衡参数族，熵最大化时退化为Boltzmann-Gibbs统计；并与超统计、随机非平衡稳态生成及贝叶斯先验推断三场景相兼容。
AI.conclusion: 该框架给出逻辑自洽、与标准贝叶斯推断兼容的受约束随机分布参考建模方法，兼具理论可扩展性与经验应用前景。

title: Dephasing-powered open quantum-dot battery
summary: We propose a simple realization of an open quantum battery powered by local dephasing. The setup consists of a triple-quantum-dot chain coupled at one end to a thermal reservoir, with the dot at the opposite end strongly detuned to form a high-energy storage element. Local dephasing populates this highly excited state and autonomously drives the system into a nonequilibrium steady state with high ergotropic efficiency. We find a limit where the ergotropic efficiency approaches unity, while the ergotropy itself approaches one-third of the energy detuning. We characterize the battery through its energy-storage performance, charging time, and stability, showing that the charged state remains long-lived after the dephasing source is switched off. We then demonstrate two complementary protocols for extracting the stored energy. First, nearly all the available ergotropy can be recovered through a simple cyclic unitary protocol involving only modulation of the detuned-dot gate. Second, coupling the detuned dot to an electronic load allows the extraction of electrochemical work exceeding the initial ergotropy, thereby accessing part of the battery's passive energy. Our results establish local dephasing as an autonomous resource for charging open quantum batteries and demonstrate simple routes for extracting the resulting stored energy in experimentally accessible mesoscopic platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由局域退相位驱动的开放量子电池：三量子点链一端接热库、另一端强失谐作高能存储单元，退相位自主将系统驱动至高ergotropic效率的非平衡稳态，并给出两种能量提取方案。
AI.motivation: 探索如何利用退相干（通常被视为有害）作为自主充电资源，构建无需外部控制、可在介观平台实现的开放量子电池。
AI.method: 构建三量子点链模型：一端耦合热库，另一端强失谐形成高能态；引入局域退相位作为驱动，分析非平衡稳态的ergotropy与ergotropic效率，并设计循环幺正协议（调制失谐门）和耦合电子负载两种提取方案。
AI.result: ergotropic效率在特定极限下趋近1，此时ergotropy约为能量失谐的三分之一；充电态在退相位关闭后寿命很长；循环幺正协议可回收几乎全部ergotropy；耦合电子负载可提取超过初始ergotropy的电化学功，从而利用部分被动能量。
AI.conclusion: 局域退相位可作为开放量子电池的自主充电资源，且所提能量提取方案在介观实验平台上简单可行。

title: Zeptojoule Microwave Calorimetry with Nanosecond Recovery in Graphene
summary: Graphene calorimeters are predicted to combine extreme energy sensitivity with rapid thermal recovery, yet experiments remain far from ideal estimates. Here, we directly calibrate a graphene Josephson-junction microwave calorimeter using nanosecond pulses and independently determine the thermal parameters of the same operating device. At 110 mK, calibrated pulse measurements yield a characteristic switching-energy scale of 18.1 meV (2.90 zJ), while time-resolved two-pulse thermometry gives an intrinsic relaxation time of 19.5 ns. Pulse-width-dependent calorimetry and bolometric thermometry show that the electronic heat capacity is 12.4 times and the electron-phonon coupling is approximately 50 times larger than ideal estimates. A thermal model using these measured parameters predicts 21.2 meV, quantitatively reproducing the observed switching response. These results identify the microscopic origin of the sensitivity gap in graphene calorimeters and establish a self-consistent calibration framework for ultrafast nanoscale thermal detectors.

AI.tldr: 本文对石墨烯约瑟夫森结微波量热计进行直接脉冲定标，并独立测定同一器件的热参数，揭示其灵敏度偏离理想估计的微观根源。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯量热计理论上兼具极高能量灵敏度与快速热恢复，但实验性能远未达到理想预期，且此前缺乏对器件热参数的独立、自洽标定。
AI.method: 在110 mK下用纳秒脉冲直接定标石墨烯约瑟夫森结微波量热计，并通过时间分辨双脉冲测温、脉宽依赖量热法与测辐射热计（bolometric）测温，独立提取电子热容和电子-声子耦合等热参数。
AI.result: 定标脉冲测量得到特征开关能标18.1 meV（2.90 zJ），双脉冲测温给出本征弛豫时间19.5 ns；测得电子热容比理想估计大约12.4倍、电子-声子耦合约大50倍；基于这些实测参数的热模型预测21.2 meV，定量再现了观测到的开关响应。
AI.conclusion: 研究明确了石墨烯量热计灵敏度差距的微观来源（热容与电子-声子耦合显著偏大），并建立了面向超快纳米热探测器的自洽标定框架。

title: First-Principles Investigation of the Structural, Electronic, Optical, Elastic, and Thermoelectric Properties of X2MoSeO6 (X = K, Rb, Cs)
summary: Understanding how alkali-metal substitution influences the coupled physical properties of molybdenum selenite oxides is essential for establishing their composition-structure-property relationships. Although the lighter members of the X2MoSeO6 family have been investigated, the heavier alkali-metal compounds remain comparatively unexplored, particularly regarding their integrated electronic, mechanical, optical, and thermoelectric responses. Here, a comprehensive first-principles investigation of X2MoSeO6 (X = K, Rb, and Cs) is presented using density functional theory and semi-classical Boltzmann transport calculations. The optimized structures exhibit progressive unit-cell expansion with increasing alkali-metal ionic size, while their indirect electronic bandgaps vary non-monotonically, reaching 2.646, 2.216, and 2.427 eV for K2MoSeO6, Rb2MoSeO6, and Cs2MoSeO6, respectively. All three structures satisfy the elastic stability criteria, with Hill-averaged bulk moduli increasing from 16.332 to 20.975 GPa across the series. K2MoSeO6 exhibits the strongest elastic anisotropy, whereas Rb2MoSeO6 possesses the highest static electronic dielectric constant (4.614) and maximum absorption coefficient (2.291*106 cm-1). Thermoelectric calculations reveal pronounced carrier-polarity-dependent behavior, with Rb2MoSeO6 attaining a positive Seebeck coefficient of 390.55e-6 V/K at 100 K and an electronic-only figure of merit (ZTe) of 7.286 at 300 K under the selected positive-Seebeck condition. By extending the investigation to the K-Rb-Cs series, this work establishes a comparative foundation for understanding and further exploring the functional characteristics of molybdenum selenite oxides.

AI.tldr: 用第一性原理系统比较X2MoSeO6 (X=K,Rb,Cs)的电子、弹性、光学与热电性质，揭示碱金属取代对结构-性质关系的影响。
AI.motivation: X2MoSeO6家族中较轻碱金属化合物已有研究，但较重的K/Rb/Cs体系在电子、力学、光学与热电综合响应方面仍缺乏系统认识，需要建立成分-结构-性质关系。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论结合半经典Boltzmann输运计算，对X2MoSeO6 (X=K,Rb,Cs)进行结构优化，并计算能带、弹性常数（Hill平均模量、各向异性）、介电与吸收系数、Seebeck系数及热电优值。
AI.result: 晶胞随碱金属离子半径增大而膨胀；间接带隙非单调变化，分别为2.646、2.216、2.427 eV；三者均满足弹性稳定性，体模量由16.332增至20.975 GPa；K2MoSeO6各向异性最强，Rb2MoSeO6静态介电常数最大(4.614)且吸收系数最高(2.291×10^6 cm-1)；热电呈载流子极性依赖，Rb2MoSeO6在100 K下Seebeck系数为390.55 μV/K，300 K下ZTe达7.286。
AI.conclusion: 通过扩展至K-Rb-Cs系列，本工作为理解及进一步探索钼硒酸盐氧化物的功能特性提供了比较基础。

title: Chemical Substitution as a Route to Anomalous Surface Superconductivity in NiBi$_3$
summary: Stabilizing two-dimensional superconductivity in a bulk superconducting material provides a unique route to exploring the interplay between superconducting condensates of different dimensionalities. Here, we present evidence for a distinct surface-associated superconducting state in Pb-substituted NiBi$_3$. NiBi$_{2.8}$Pb$_{0.2}$ exhibits a resistive onset at $T_{c,\mathrm{onset}}^{*}\approx8.1$~K, nearly twice the bulk superconducting transition temperature of approximately 4.1~K. The absence of a corresponding Meissner response or specific-heat anomaly at the higher-temperature transition supports its non-bulk origin. A cusp-like angular dependence of the critical field, well described by the two-dimensional Tinkham model, together with nonlinear current--voltage characteristics and signatures of a Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless transition, establishes the low-dimensional character of this superconducting state. Remarkably, the surface-associated superconductivity persists well beyond the bulk upper critical field, reaching a maximum ratio of $H_{c3}/H_{c2}\approx4.3$, far exceeding the conventional Saint-James--de Gennes value of 1.695. These results demonstrate that Pb substitution can stabilize an anomalously enhanced low-dimensional superconducting state in NiBi$_3$, providing a platform for investigating superconductivity at the boundary of a bulk superconductor.

AI.tldr: 在Pb替代的NiBi3中观测到一种面关联的二维超导态，其转变温度约8.1 K，约为体超导转变温度(约4.1 K)的两倍，且表现出二维Tinkham临界场行为和BKT特征。
AI.motivation: 在体超导材料中稳定二维超导，可为研究不同维度超导凝聚体之间的相互作用提供独特途径。作者希望探索NiBi3体系中是否存在由Pb替代诱导的低维表面超导态。
AI.method: 对Pb替代样品NiBi2.8Pb0.2进行输运测量：分析电阻转变、迈斯纳响应与比热以判断是否为体效应；测量临界场的角度依赖并用二维Tinkham模型拟合；测量非线性电流-电压特性以寻找BKT转变特征；并比较表面超导的上临界场Hc3与体Hc2。
AI.result: 样品在Tc,onset*≈8.1 K出现电阻起始转变，约为体转变温度4.1 K的两倍；在更高温度转变处无对应迈斯纳响应或比热异常，说明其非体起源。临界场呈尖点状角度依赖，符合二维Tinkham模型；非线性I-V及BKT特征证实低维性质。表面超导可持续超过体上临界场，Hc3/Hc2最大约4.3，远超Saint-James–de Gennes值1.695。
AI.conclusion: Pb替代可在NiBi3中稳定一种异常增强的低维超导态，为研究体超导体边界处的超导性提供平台。

title: Charge state and hydration of vacancies in silicon and silicon carbide in contact with water: A grand-canonical first-principles stability map
summary: The state of a vacancy in a semiconductor is normally described by the Fermi level alone. In wet-etched, electrochemically processed, or humid silicon and silicon carbide, a vacancy also takes up hydrogen and oxygen from water, in amounts set by pH and electrode potential. We treat both effects together by minimizing the grand potential of a vacancy complex over its charge state and hydrogen/oxygen content. The result is a stability map in Fermi level and hydrogen chemical potential, which the computational hydrogen electrode relates to pH and potential. We parameterize it with spin-polarized density functional theory in 64-atom cells, including the vibrational free energy of bound H and O, for the silicon vacancy, its H, O, and OH complexes, and both vacancies of 3C-SiC. Hydrogen binds cooperatively to the silicon vacancy, which goes directly from bare to fully passivated $V$H$_4$. In contact with water the bare vacancy is never the lowest-energy state. Near neutral pH it binds oxygen from water as the A center, the paramagnetic hydroxyl complex forms below about pH 5 at zero bias, and full passivation to $V$H$_4$ requires cathodic bias. In PBE the Fermi level barely moves these boundaries, because the acceptor levels lie at or above the conduction-band edge. In SiC the first hydrogen binds to the silicon vacancy by 1.97 eV but is unbound at the carbon vacancy (the $Z_{1/2}$ center), so hydrogen from water alone should not passivate it except under cathodic bias.

AI.tldr: 论文用自旋极化DFT构建空位复合体的稳定性图，将费米能级与氢氧化势（pH、电极电位）统一处理，揭示Si与3C-SiC空位在位错/湿法条件下被H和O占据的真实基态。
AI.motivation: 半导体空位通常仅用费米能级描述，但在湿法刻蚀、电化学或潮湿环境下，空位会从水中吸收H和O，量由pH和电极电位决定；仅用费米能级无法描述这一真实状态。
AI.method: 对空位复合体的大势在其电荷态与H/O含量上取极小化，得到费米能级-氢化学势稳定性图，并用计算氢电极关联pH与电位；用64原子胞自旋极化DFT（PBE）参数化，包含束缚H/O的振动自由能，覆盖Si空位及其H、O、OH复合体与3C-SiC两种空位。
AI.result: H协同结合于Si空位，从裸空位直接过渡到完全钝化的VH4；接触水时裸空位从不是最低能态。近中性pH下以A中心形式结合O，零偏压下pH<5时形成顺磁羟基复合体，完全钝化需阴极偏压。PBE中受主能级位于导带边及以上，故费米能级几乎不移动这些边界。3C-SiC中H首次结合Si空位放热1.97 eV，但在碳空位（Z1/2中心）不结合，故单靠水中H除阴极偏压外无法钝化它。
AI.conclusion: 空位的真实稳定性必须同时考虑电荷态与H/O化学环境；稳定性图可预测湿法/电化学/潮湿条件下Si与SiC空位的H、O占据与钝化行为，SiC的Z1/2中心对氢钝化有强烈抗性。

title: Large spin large deviations for interacting particle systems
summary:
We propose a novel framework for analyzing the sample-path large deviations of interacting particle systems directly on a lattice by considering a large-spin limit ($s \to \infty$). Through an appropriate scaling of variables, the process concentrates around its deterministic trajectory, governed by the lattice diffusion equation. We quantify the exponential cost of observing atypical trajectories by explicitly computing the path-space large deviation rate function from the scaled microscopic generator, based on a theory due to Feng and Kurtz. The rate function is described in terms of a Hamiltonian on a lattice in terms of classical spin variables. Notably, for our main model, the symmetric harmonic process, the corresponding Hamiltonian is identified with the classical integrable non-compact Ishimori spin chain.
  Furthermore, we show that our large spin large deviation theory is fully consistent with traditional Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory (MFT), smoothly recovering the standard MFT Hamiltonian in the spatial continuous limit. We also perform a Poisson-noise Martin--Siggia--Rose (MSR) computation to derive the non-linear lattice Hamiltonian directly from microscopic dynamics, use a relative entropy argument to obtain the density-current action, and establish the lattice fluctuation theorem alongside its symmetry origin. Overall, our framework provides a naturally regularized, lattice analogue of MFT that circumvents spatial ultraviolet singularities and possible continuous density blow-ups.
  We also apply our new scheme to partial symmetric exclusion process, symmetric inclusion processes, Brownian energy process and integrable heat conduction model, showing how their large-deviation Hamiltonians relate to classical compact and non-compact spin chains.

AI.tldr: 提出基于大自旋极限(s→∞)的格点相互作用粒子系统样本路径大偏差框架，显式计算路径空间速率函数，得到格点哈密顿量，并将对称调和过程对应到经典可积非紧致Ishimori自旋链，同时在空间连续极限下恢复标准MFT哈密顿量。
AI.motivation: 传统宏观涨落理论(MFT)在空间连续情形存在紫外奇异性与密度爆破问题，需要一个天然正则在格点层面刻画涨落大偏差的类比框架。
AI.method: 通过对变量的适当缩放，使大自旋极限下过程集中于由格点扩散方程支配的确定性轨迹；基于Feng–Kurtz理论从缩放后的微观生成元显式计算路径空间大偏差速率函数，用经典自旋变量在格点上表述哈密顿量；并辅以Poisson噪声MSR计算、相对熵论证及格点涨落定理的对称性起源分析。
AI.result: 对称调和过程的哈密顿量被识别为经典可积非紧致Ishimori自旋链；大自旋大偏差理论与传统MFT完全一致，在空间连续极限下平滑恢复标准MFT哈密顿量；由MSR与相对熵方法得到密度-流作用量并建立格点涨落定理；并将方案应用于部分对称排斥过程、对称包含过程、Brownian能量过程及可积热传导模型，揭示其大偏差哈密顿量与经典紧致/非紧致自旋链的联系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了MFT的自然正则化格点类比，规避空间紫外奇异性和可能的连续密度爆破，并将粒子系统大偏差与经典可积自旋链理论联系起来。

title: Phonon-Dressed Quasiparticles in Epitaxial Scandium Nitride Resolved by Soft X-ray ARPES
summary: Electron-phonon interactions govern quasiparticle energies, lifetimes, and temperature-dependent band structures in semiconductors. However, direct momentum-resolved experimental evidence of their impact on quasiparticle electronic structure remains scarce, particularly in nitride semiconductors. Here, we present conclusive experimental evidence of electron-phonon interaction-induced quasiparticle renormalization and pronounced spectral broadening in p-type scandium nitride (ScN), using soft x-ray angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. First-principles spectral-function calculations due to electron-phonon coupling reproduce the measured spectra, capturing a pronounced quasiparticle kink ~2.3 eV below the valence-band maximum, phonon satellite features arising from long-range electron-phonon coupling, and a direct bandgap zero-point renormalization of -124.3 meV within the non-adiabatic Allen-Heine-Cardona approach. We further show that the anomalous temperature-induced increase in the direct bandgap in ScN originates from the combined effects of thermal expansion and electron-phonon coupling, contributing comparably near room temperature. Our results establish ScN as a model platform for visualizing electron-phonon coupling and provide a quantitative benchmark for predictive first-principles descriptions of quasiparticle renormalization in semiconductors.

AI.tldr: 该文用软X射线角分辨光电子能谱（SX-ARPES）在p型ScN中直接观测到电子-声子耦合导致的准粒子重整化与谱展宽，并用第一性原理谱函数计算定量复现，给出零温直接带隙重整化-124.3 meV及温度诱导带隙反常增大的双机制解释。
AI.motivation: 电子-声子相互作用决定了半导体的准粒子能量、寿命和温度依赖能带结构，但动量分辨的直接实验证据仍十分匮乏，氮化物半导体尤甚；同时ScN中温度升高使直接带隙异常增大的微观起源尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对p型ScN开展软X射线角分辨光电子能谱测量，获得动量分辨的能带与谱线形状；采用非绝热Allen-Heine-Cardona框架进行第一性原理谱函数计算，包含长程电子-声子耦合，与实验谱直接对比。
AI.result: 实验谱中观测到价带顶以下约2.3 eV处的显著准粒子kink、源于长程电子-声子耦合的声子卫星结构以及明显的谱展宽；理论谱函数定量复现了这些特征。计算给出直接带隙零温重整化约-124.3 meV；并表明近室温下ScN直接带隙随温度的反常增大由热膨胀与电子-声子耦合共同贡献，两者量级相当。
AI.conclusion: ScN可作为可视化电子-声子耦合的模型体系，本工作为半导体准粒子重整化的第一性原理预测提供了定量基准。

title: First-order magnetostructural transition in Ni-Mn-Sn powder - A matter of particle and grain size
summary: In Ni-Mn-based Heusler alloys, the magnetocaloric effect originates from a first-order magnetostructural transition (FOMST). However, the influence of particle and grain size on thermal hysteresis, transition width, and nucleation and growth mechanism remains poorly understood, as mechanical grinding can introduce residual stresses and processing-induced defects. In this study, we examined the size dependence of the FOMST in gas-atomized Ni-Mn-Sn powder by combining microstructural characterization with temperature-dependent XRD, magnetometry, calorimetry and single-particle measurements, enabling decoupling of size dependence from processing-related influences. We observed a pronounced size dependence of the transition ranges (Ms-Mf) and (Af-As), which decrease with decreasing particle size and approach zero for single-crystalline particles below ~20-30 micrometer. The thermal hysteresis decreases with increasing particle size, reaching a lower limit of 17 K for large polycrystalline particles above 100 micrometer. EBSD reveals a nearly constant grain size, implying a transition from polycrystalline to single-crystalline particles as particle size decreases. In polycrystalline particles, multiple grains transform gradually over an extended temperature interval because grain boundaries act as barriers to the progression of transformation. In contrast, single-grain particles lack preferred nucleation sites, resulting in larger hysteresis, while the absence of barriers to transformation propagation causes the entire particle to transform in a narrow range. These results demonstrate that the size dependence of the FOMST is governed by the interplay between particle size, grain boundaries, and the free particle surface.

AI.tldr: 研究气雾化Ni-Mn-Sn粉末中一级磁结构相变(FOMST)的尺寸依赖：相变温区随颗粒尺寸减小而减小，单晶小颗粒趋近零；热滞随尺寸增大而减小，源于晶界与自由表面的竞争。
AI.motivation: Ni-Mn基Heusler合金的磁热效应源自一级磁结构相变，但颗粒与晶粒尺寸对热滞、相变宽度及形核-长大机制的影响尚不清楚——机械研磨会引入残余应力和加工缺陷，无法将尺寸效应与加工影响解耦。
AI.method: 采用气雾化Ni-Mn-Sn粉末（避免研磨引入缺陷），结合微观结构表征与变温XRD、磁测量、量热及单颗粒测量，实现尺寸效应与加工影响的解耦；用EBSD评估晶粒尺寸随颗粒尺寸的变化。
AI.result: 相变温区(Ms-Mf)与(Af-As)随颗粒尺寸减小而显著减小，在~20-30 μm以下的单晶颗粒中趋近零；热滞随颗粒增大而减小，100 μm以上大多晶颗粒降至17 K下限。EBSD显示晶粒尺寸近乎恒定，说明颗粒减小时发生多晶到单晶的转变。
AI.conclusion: 多晶颗粒中晶界阻碍相变推进，多晶粒在宽温区内逐步转变；单晶颗粒缺乏优先形核位点导致热滞较大，却因无扩展阻碍而使整个颗粒在窄温区完成转变。FOMST的尺寸依赖由颗粒尺寸、晶界和自由表面三者相互作用共同决定。

title: Exact Magnetic Confinement of a Doped Hole by Kinetic Frustration
summary: We establish an exact mechanism of magnetic confinement driven purely by kinetic frustration. In a finite open sawtooth $U=\infty$ Hubbard chain of $L$ unit cells doped with one hole, the ground state at magnetization $M$ contains $M$ polarized triplet dimers surrounding a connected singlet region of length $\ell_{\rm s}=L-M$. A magnetic field selects $M$ and hence the confinement length. The hole forms a standing wave in the singlet region with exponential tails in the triplet background. Confinement requires neither disorder nor an exchange-generated string tension: destructive interference between direct and apex-mediated hopping makes the triplet bonds reflecting. At $t_2/t_1=[2+4\cos(π/(\ell_{\rm s}+2))]^{-1/2}$, they become perfectly reflecting, producing a position-degenerate compact localized state. At every fixed field $0<h<h_{\rm sat}$, the singlet region remains finite as $L\to\infty$ and shrinks stepwise with increasing field, whereas at $h=0$ it spans the system.

AI.tldr: 在有限开边界锯齿型U=∞ Hubbard链中，磁性约束完全由动力学阻挫驱动：磁化M对应M个极化三重态二聚体包围一个单重态区域，其长度ℓ_s=L−M由磁场调控，无需无序或交换诱导的弦张力。
AI.motivation: 探索不依赖无序或交换生成弦张力的磁性约束新机制，揭示阻挫Hubbard体系中磁场如何选择约束长度。
AI.method: 研究单空穴掺杂的有限开锯齿型U=∞ Hubbard链，分析基态在磁化M下的结构，并考察空穴在单重态区形成的驻波及其在三重态背景中的指数尾。
AI.result: 三重态键因直接跳跃与顶点介导跳跃的破坏性干涉而具反射性；当t_2/t_1=[2+4cos(π/(ℓ_s+2))]^{-1/2}时完全反射，形成位置简并的紧致局域态。任意固定场0<h<h_sat下，单重态区域随L→∞保持有限并随场增大阶梯式收缩；h=0时则铺展至整个系统。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了纯动力学阻挫导致精确磁性约束的机制，磁场成为约束长度的调控参量。

title: Co layer Thickness Driven Structural Evolution and Magnetic Behaviour of Co/Ir/Co Trilayers
summary: Ferromagnetic heavy-metal (FM/HM) trilayer heterostructures provide a versatile platform for investigating the interplay between structural and magnetic properties. In this study, we investigate the effect of Co-layer thickness on the structural and magnetic properties of sputter-deposited $\mathrm{Co}(t_{\mathrm{Co}})/\mathrm{Ir}(5\,\mathrm{nm})/\mathrm{Co}(t_{\mathrm{Co}})$ varying from 2 to 10 nm. Structural characterization using grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) and high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) reveals a nanocrystalline structure, with the crystallite size increasing with Co-layer thickness. Furthermore, X-ray reflectivity (XRR) reveals a thickness-dependent variation in interface morphology, with the interface roughness ratio reaching a maximum at $t_{\mathrm{Co}} = 4$ nm. Temperature-dependent zero-field-cooled and field-cooled (ZFC-FC) magnetization measurements reveal thickness-dependent characteristic temperatures and multiple relaxation regimes in selected samples, indicating complex thermally activated magnetic behaviour. In contrast, field-dependent hysteresis measurements reveal that the saturation magnetization increases with Co-layer thickness, whereas the coercivity exhibits a pronounced non-monotonic variation, with enhanced values at intermediate thicknesses. Moreover, low-temperature hysteresis loops display thickness-dependent exchange-bias-like shifts, particularly for $t_{\mathrm{Co}} = 2$-$4$ nm. These findings highlight the strong influence of Co-layer thickness on the structural and magnetic properties of Co/Ir/Co trilayers.

AI.tldr: 研究Co层厚度(2–10 nm)对溅射Co/Ir/Co三层膜结构与磁性的影响，发现结晶尺寸、界面粗糙度、饱和磁化、矫顽力及交换偏置样位移均随厚度呈现显著变化。
AI.motivation: 铁磁/重金属三层异质结是研究结构与磁性关联的良好平台，Co层厚度对其结构与磁性的具体调控机制尚需系统研究。
AI.method: 制备不同Co厚度(2–10 nm)的Co(t)/Ir(5 nm)/Co(t)溅射三层膜；用GIXRD与HRTEM表征结构，XRR分析界面形貌，ZFC-FC和变场磁滞回线测量磁性。
AI.result: 薄膜为纳米晶结构，晶粒尺寸随Co厚度增大；界面粗糙度比在t_Co=4 nm处最大；ZFC-FC显示随厚度变化的特征温度与多种弛豫机制；饱和磁化随厚度增大，矫顽力呈非单调变化并在中间厚度增强；t_Co=2–4 nm低温回线出现类交换偏置位移。
AI.conclusion: Co层厚度显著调控Co/Ir/Co三层膜的结构与磁性，中间厚度区间出现矫顽力增强与交换偏置样效应，为调控此类异质结性能提供依据。

title: Second-Harmonic Bulk Response of Fractional Quantum Hall Fluids
summary: We develop a bulk description for the second-harmonic Hall response of fractional quantum Hall fluids with broken inversion and rotational symmetries, distinct from edge theories based on nonlinear edge-mode dispersion. By projecting a tilted massive Dirac model onto a single low-energy band, we construct a composite-boson Chern--Simons theory for the lowest Landau level that retains projection-induced nonlinear electromagnetic couplings. The nonlinear Hall resistivity vanishes in the dc limit, while its finite-frequency response retains the characteristic filling-factor dependence $ρ^{(2)}_{TLL}\proptoν^{-2}$, where $ν$ is the Landau-level filling factor. At low frequency, its real and imaginary parts scale as $(ω/ω_c)^2$ and $ω/ω_c$, respectively, where $ω_c$ is the cyclotron frequency, and the response is strongly anisotropic with respect to the crystalline tilt axis. Notably, the Kohn-mode resonances present in the second-order conductivity cancel in the nonlinear Hall resistivity. These results establish finite-frequency nonlinear transport as a bulk probe of fractional quantum Hall fluids without requiring nonlinear edge-mode dispersion.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将倾斜大质量Dirac模型投影到单一低能朗道能级，构建了保留投影诱导非线性电磁耦合的复合玻色子Chern–Simons理论，用于描述破缺反演与旋转对称性的分数量子霍尔流体的二阶谐波霍尔响应，并研究其有限频率非线性输运性质。
AI.motivation: 现有描述分数量子霍尔非线性输运的理论多依赖基于非线性边缘模色散（TLL）的边缘理论。作者希望建立一个不依赖边缘模非线性色散的"体"描述，来刻画破缺反演和旋转对称性时的二阶谐波霍尔响应，从而确立有限频率非线性输运作为分数量子霍尔流体的体探针。
AI.method: 将倾斜大质量Dirac模型投影到单个低能带（最低朗道能级），构建最低朗道能级的复合玻色子Chern–Simons理论，保留投影产生的非线性电磁耦合，并据此计算二阶谐波（非线性霍尔）电阻率在直流与有限频率下的响应。
AI.result: 非线性霍尔电阻率在直流极限下消失；有限频率响应保留特征性填充因子依赖 ρ^(2)_TLL ∝ ν^{-2}。低频下实部与虚部分别按 (ω/ω_c)^2 和 ω/ω_c 标度（ω_c为回旋频率），且响应相对晶格倾斜轴呈强各向异性。值得注意的是，二阶电导中的Kohn模共振在非线性霍尔电阻率中相互抵消。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了无需非线性边缘模色散的有限频率非线性输运，作为探测分数量子霍尔流体的体探针，为从体（bulk）角度研究分数量子霍尔非线性响应提供了新框架。

title: Perpendicular Anisotropy and g-Factor of Sputtered Ni Films on Si(111) Studied by Angle-Dependent Ferromagnetic Resonance
summary: Ni films with thicknesses of 312 and 1011\,Å were grown on Si(111) by dc magnetron sputtering at room temperature and studied by atomic force microscopy, grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction, X-ray reflectivity, magnetometry and angle-dependent ferromagnetic resonance. Both films are polycrystalline fcc Ni with smooth surfaces, a bulk-like (111) lattice spacing and a saturation magnetization of ${\approx}480$\,emu\,cm$^{-3}$, and both are magnetized in plane. The angular dependence of the resonance field, from the film plane to the film normal, is described by a uniaxial anisotropy model with first- and second-order terms. From this model, $g = 2.160\pm0.005$ and $2.101\pm0.014$ and effective perpendicular anisotropies of $(6.0\pm0.4)\times10^{5}$ and $(4.5\pm0.6)\times10^{5}$\,erg\,cm$^{-3}$ were obtained for the thinner and thicker film, respectively. The conventional analysis of only the in-plane and perpendicular resonances gives $g$-factors that are lower by 0.02--0.04. The perpendicular linewidths give upper limits for the Gilbert damping of $α\le 0.030$ and $\le 0.038$.

AI.tldr: 研究了室温直流磁控溅射在Si(111)上生长的312 Å和1011 Å厚Ni薄膜，用AFM、掠入射XRD、X射线反射、磁强计和角度相关铁磁共振进行表征，并用含一阶、二阶项的单轴各向异性模型拟合共振场角依赖，得到g因子和有效垂直各向异性。
AI.motivation: Ni薄膜的磁各向异性与g因子、阻尼等动态参数对薄膜厚度敏感，需要系统表征不同厚度Ni膜的结构与磁动力学性质，并说明仅取面内与垂直两个共振位置的传统分析方法可能引入的偏差。
AI.method: 室温直流磁控溅射在Si(111)上生长312 Å与1011 Å Ni膜；用AFM、掠入射XRD、X射线反射、磁强计和角度依赖铁磁共振表征；以含一阶和二阶项的单轴各向异性模型拟合从膜面到膜法向的共振场角依赖，并据此提取g、有效垂直各向异性和Gilbert阻尼上限。
AI.result: 两膜均为多晶fcc Ni，表面光滑，具有体态(111)晶面间距和约480 emu/cm³的饱和磁化强度，且均为面内磁化。拟合得到较薄膜g=2.160±0.005、较厚膜g=2.101±0.014；有效垂直各向异性分别为(6.0±0.4)×10⁵和(4.5±0.6)×10⁵ erg/cm³。仅用面内和垂直共振的传统分析所得g因子偏低0.02–0.04。垂直方向线宽给出Gilbert阻尼上限α≤0.030（312 Å）和≤0.038（1011 Å）。
AI.conclusion: Ni膜的结构与静态磁性接近体态，但动态参数（g因子、垂直各向异性、阻尼）随厚度变化；角度分辨FMR结合完整单轴各向异性模型比仅用面内/垂直两点更可靠，后者会系统性低估g因子。该工作为超薄Ni膜磁动力学参数提取提供了方法与数据参考。

title: Effect of niobium doping on the local structure and oxidation state of Co atoms in SrTiO$_3$
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables; authors' translation to appear in Physics of the Solid State
summary: XAFS spectroscopy combined with first-principles calculations are used to study SrTiO$_3$ samples simultaneously doped with cobalt and niobium. It is shown that additional doping of the samples with Nb donors results in a decrease in the oxidation state of cobalt atoms to +2, which is accompanied by an increase in the Co--O distance to the nearest oxygen atoms, in agreement with first-principles calculations. The impurity Co atoms are shown to occupy Ti sites and are on-center. The suppression of the oxygen-vacancy formation upon doping SrTiO$_3$(Co) with niobium was revealed. First-principles calculations indicate that the Coulomb interaction of ions with local electric fields generated by non-isoelectronic Nb impurities plays a decisive role in the local distortions of atomic positions observed around the cobalt atom in the unit cell. The possibility of controlling the magnetic moment of Co atoms by intentional change in the lattice parameter is demonstrated.

AI.tldr: 结合XAFS谱学与第一性原理计算，研究Co、Nb共掺杂SrTiO₃中Co的价态、局域结构与氧空位行为。
AI.motivation: 探究SrTiO₃中Co与Nb共掺杂时杂质原子的价态、占位及局域畸变机制，特别是Nb施主掺杂如何改变Co的氧化态与氧空位形成，并寻找调控磁矩的手段。
AI.method: 以XAFS光谱实验结合第一性原理计算，分析Co、Nb共掺杂SrTiO₃中Co的氧化态与Co–O键长；判定Co的占位与偏离位情况；研究氧空位形成趋势；用计算解释局域电场导致原子位置畸变的机制。
AI.result: Nb施主共掺杂使Co氧化态降至+2并伴随Co–O距离增大，与计算一致；Co占据Ti位且为on-center；Nb掺杂抑制氧空位形成；计算表明非等电子Nb杂质产生的局域电场与离子的库仑相互作用是Co周围局域畸变的主因；通过改变晶格参数可调控Co磁矩。
AI.conclusion: Nb共掺杂可有效调控SrTiO₃中Co的价态、局域结构与缺陷形成，局域电场是畸变的关键，晶格参数调控为磁矩设计提供途径。

title: Harnessing Electrostructural Bistability to Control Defects in Polarizable Materials
summary: Structural defects are central to the functionalities of materials. However, conventional approaches to defect control are often slow and imprecise. This work identifies and characterizes a distinct physical phenomenon of electrostructural bistability that provides a rapid and precise pathway for engineering materials with defect-controlled physical properties. A generalized theory of conductivity bistability is developed and experimentally validated to unify two distinct regimes: previously reported electrothermal bistability in weakly polarizable insulators, such as silicon, and electrostructural bistability in strongly polarizable materials, such as TiO$_2$. In agreement with the theory, experiments on TiO$_2$ demonstrate that bulk-homogeneous defect concentrations in electrostructurally bistable materials can be tuned rapidly and deterministically by controlling applied electric current. Abruptly interrupting the current quenches the system into long-lived, room-temperature metastable states with distinct properties. This establishes a practical, rapid, and scalable pathway for defect engineering with direct relevance to nonvolatile memory devices.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并表征了"电结构双稳态"这一新物理现象，建立统一的电导双稳态理论，并在TiO2中实验验证，为快速、精准、可扩展的缺陷工程及非易失存储器件提供新路径。
AI.motivation: 传统缺陷控制方法缓慢且不精确，亟需快速、精准调控材料缺陷浓度以定制物理性能的手段。
AI.method: 建立统一的电导双稳态广义理论，将弱极化绝缘体（如硅）的电热双稳态与强极化材料（如TiO2）的电结构双稳态统一起来，并在TiO2上开展实验验证。
AI.result: 理论与实验一致表明，电结构双稳态材料中体相均匀缺陷浓度可通过控制电流快速、确定性地调节；突然切断电流可将系统淬火至长寿命的室温亚稳态，并具有不同物性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了一条实用、快速且可扩展的缺陷工程途径，直接适用于非易失存储器件。

title: Chiral Superconductivity Adjacent to a Wigner Crystal in Rhombohedral Graphene
summary: Can the correlations favoring electron crystallization also generate superconductivity in the neighboring metal? We investigate this possibility in rhombohedral tetralayer graphene with repulsive Coulomb interactions. Self-consistent Hartree--Fock calculations identify a commensurate triangular Wigner-crystal state. To investigate pairing on the metallic side, we construct a crossing-symmetric particle--hole vertex using coupled parquet and Bethe--Salpeter equations, incorporating exchange vertex corrections beyond polarization-bubble screening. Near crystallization, the enhanced electronic correlations generate an effective attraction favoring chiral $f$-wave pairing. Superconductivity is confined to a narrow metallic region adjacent to the crystal, qualitatively consistent with the superconducting sleeve observed near an insulating regime in rhombohedral graphene. These results connect the emergence of chiral pairing and its location in the phase diagram to the electronic correlations favoring crystallization.

AI.tldr: 本文在菱面四层石墨烯中研究促进电子结晶的关联能否在邻近金属区诱导超导，自洽Hartree-Fock给出公度三角Wigner晶体，并用交叉对称粒子-空穴顶角（parquet+Bethe-Salpeter）发现近结晶区出现手性f波配对。
AI.motivation: 实验上菱面石墨烯中绝缘（结晶）区域附近观测到"超导套筒"，但促进电子结晶的库仑关联是否也能在同一体系中驱动超导配对、以及超导为何定位于晶体近旁，尚缺乏微观机制解释。
AI.method: 在菱面四层石墨烯中考虑排斥库仑相互作用：用自洽Hartree-Fock识别公度三角Wigner晶体态；在金属侧构建交叉对称的粒子-空穴顶角，结合耦合parquet方程与Bethe-Salpeter方程，并纳入超越极化气泡屏蔽的交换顶角修正，以求解配对不稳定性。
AI.result: 自洽Hartree-Fock确认公度三角Wigner晶体态；近结晶区增强的电子关联产生有效吸引，偏好手性f波配对；超导仅局限于紧邻晶体的狭窄金属区，定性符合菱面石墨烯中绝缘区附近观测到的超导套筒。
AI.conclusion: 手性配对的出现及其在相图中的位置可由促进结晶的电子关联统一解释，将Wigner结晶与邻近超导联系起来，为菱面石墨烯中"超导套筒"提供理论依据。

title: Scattering and Schmid-Bulgadaev Transition in Qubits Based on Josephson Junction Chains
summary: A Josephson junction subject to an ohmic dissipative environment undergoes a zero-temperature quantum phase transition called Schmid-Bulgadaev transition form an insulating state to a superconducting state upon increasing the impedance of the environment above the resistance quantum. Superconducting qubits based on Josephson junction chains represent a system where it is possible to dynamically explore both sides of this transition by probing the scattering of individual plasma modes of the junction chain on a SQUID at the boundary which was achieved in recent experiments. Here, we provide a theoretical analysis of the scattering in the system paying special attention to the non-perturbative superconducting regime. We find that in this regime, a specific diagrammatic resummation must be performed in order to correctly account for fluctuation renormalization of the SQUID's potential. We find analytic expressions for the modes' frequency shifts and quality factors which together provide a full description of scattering. We argue that the non-perturbative nature of the superconducting phase manifests itself through a power-law dependence of the frequency shifts on the SQUID flux and through non-monotonous dependence of the quality factors on the mode frequency. Our predictions may be readily verified in modern low-temperature experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文对约瑟夫森结链中等离子体模式在边界SQUID上的散射进行理论分析，重点处理非微扰超导区间，通过特定图形重求和正确计入SQUID势的涨落重整化，给出模式频移与品质因数的解析表达式。
AI.motivation: 基于约瑟夫森结链的超导量子比特可在实验上动态探测Schmid-Bulgadaev量子相变（绝缘态—超导态）两侧，近期实验已实现等离子体模式在边界SQUID上的散射测量，但缺乏对非微扰超导区散射的完整理论描述。
AI.method: 对ohmic耗散环境中的约瑟夫森结链—SQUID散射体系做微扰/非微扰理论分析；在超导区实施特定的图形重求和（diagrammatic resummation），以正确考虑SQUID势的涨落重整化。
AI.result: 得到模式频移与品质因数的解析表达式，从而完整描述散射；指出非微扰超导相表现为频移对SQUID磁通的幂律依赖，以及品质因数对模式频率的非单调依赖。
AI.conclusion: 非微扰超导区的涨落重整化对散射描述至关重要；所预言的特征（幂律频移、非单调品质因数）可在当前低温实验条件下直接检验。

title: Emergent parafermions with tunable localization in a quantum circuit network
summary: \noindent Quantum circuit simulators with hybrid metal-semiconductor dots provide a versatile platform to realize Kondo anyons. These arise at critical points driven by frustrated Kondo screening of dot charge degrees of freedom and have been demonstrated experimentally in linear circuits of one or two dots. Here we study a triangular triple dot device, where geometric frustration gives rise to an emergent $\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion shared among the three dots. We show that the parafermion can be tunably relocated to any pair of dots by applying gate voltages, and is supported in both the weak-tunneling `Kondo limit' and the strong transmission `quasiballistic' regime. The critical states survive strong coupling to external leads and other dots, establishing the basis for a scalable and reconfigurable network architecture in which non-Abelian excitations can be realized and manipulated.

AI.tldr: 研究三角三量子点器件，几何阻挫产生三量子点共享的Z3 parafermion（Kondo anyon），可通过栅压可调移至任意两量子点间，在弱隧穿Kondo极限与强透射准弹道区均存在。
AI.motivation: 混合金属-半导体量子点电路的量子模拟器可实现Kondo任意子，此前仅在一到两个点的线性电路中实验演示；本文探索如何利用几何阻挫实现更丰富、可扩展的非阿贝尔激发平台。
AI.method: 理论/数值研究三角形三量子点器件，分析阻挫Kondo屏蔽驱动的临界点，考察栅压调控parafermion位置，并在Kondo极限（弱隧穿）和准弹道区（强透射）两种机制下验证其稳定性，同时测试对外部引线与其他量子点强耦合的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 三量子点中涌现出共享的Z3 parafermion；通过栅压可将parafermion可调地移动到任意一对量子点之间；该临界态在弱隧穿与强透射两个区域均存在，且能经受与外部引线及其他量子点的强耦合。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了可实现和操控非阿贝尔激发的可扩展、可重构网络架构基础，为基于多量子点Kondo任意子的拓扑量子计算提供可行方案。

title: First-Principles-Informed Modeling of Thermal Transport and Laser-Induced Heating in Ultrahigh-Temperature Carbides
summary: Using first-principles density functional theory and Boltzmann transport calculations, we systematically investigate the electronic structure, lattice and electronic thermal transport, optical response, and laser-induced heating of ultrahigh-temperature carbides (UHTCs), including Group IV (TiC, ZrC, and HfC) and Group V carbides (VC, NbC, and TaC), and SiC. The transition-metal carbides (TMCs) exhibit metallic electronic structures, whereas SiC exhibits semiconducting character. The calculated thermal transport properties reveal distinct contributions from phonons and electrons, with electronic heat transport becoming increasingly important at elevated temperatures in TMCs. The Group V carbides exhibit substantially lower lattice thermal conductivity than their Group IV counterparts, accompanied by pronounced Kohn anomalies and modified phonon dispersions associated with their distinct electronic structures, suggesting a possible connection between Fermi-surface topology, phonon dynamics, and lattice thermal transport. In contrast, SiC exhibits comparatively high lattice thermal conductivity, consistent with its long-lived acoustic phonons, but no electronic contribution due to its semiconducting nature. Optical calculations reveal relatively high reflectivity in the visible and infrared spectral ranges for the metallic carbides, whereas SiC exhibits lower reflectivity in the infrared region. Finally, one-dimensional and three-dimensional continuum heat-conduction models are employed to compare the thermal responses of these materials under specified laser irradiation conditions. The predicted temperature distributions depend on the thermal and optical properties of the materials as well as the specimen geometry.

AI.tldr: 用第一性原理DFT与玻尔兹曼输运计算系统研究了IV族(TiC/ZrC/HfC)、V族(VC/NbC/TaC)碳化物及SiC的电子结构、声子与电子热输运、光学响应和激光诱导加热。
AI.motivation: 超高温碳化物(UHTCs)在高温与激光辐照环境下的热输运与光学行为尚缺乏系统、统一的第一性原理层面的认识，尤其是晶格与电子热导的贡献划分、V族与IV族差异的物理根源等问题不清楚。
AI.method: 第一性原理密度泛函理论结合玻尔兹曼输运方程，计算电子结构与声子/电子热导、光学响应；并用一维和三维连续介质热传导模型模拟特定激光辐照下的温度场。
AI.result: 过渡金属碳化物呈金属性，SiC为半导体；TMCs中电子热输运随温度升高愈发重要。V族碳化物的晶格热导显著低于IV族，并伴随明显Kohn异常与声子色散改变，暗示费米面拓扑-声子动力学-晶格热导之间存在联系。SiC声学声子寿命长、晶格热导高且无电子贡献。金属碳化物在可见-红外反射率较高，SiC红外反射率较低。温度分布取决于热学/光学性质与样品几何。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为UHTCs高温热管理与激光加工应用提供了系统的热学与光学性质数据库，并揭示费米面拓扑与声子动力学可能是理解V族/IV族晶格热导差异的关键。

title: Annealing-atmosphere control of paramagnetic defects in ZnO microparticles
summary: In this work, we used temperature-dependent electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy to reveal the effect of high-temperature annealing in N2 and air on paramagnetic and electronic properties of ZnO microparticles. EPR spectral simulations have shown that N2 annealing produces Zni, VO+, and shallow-donor centers, whereas Zni, VO+, and Hi-related centers are observed after annealing the ZnO microparticles in an air atmosphere. The resolved paramagnetic centers exhibit distinctly different behavior over 5-297 K. The shallow-donor and Hi signals are rapidly quenched below approximately 50 K, while the Zni contribution shows a nonmonotonic temperature dependence. In contrast, the VO+ signal persists up to room temperature and increases with temperature, consistent with charge redistribution among donor-related defects involving deep oxygen-vacancy states. The cavity Q-factor generally decreases with increasing temperature for both annealed samples, indicating atmosphere-dependent changes in the microwave losses. These results show that the annealing atmosphere controls the paramagnetic defect population, the temperature dependence of donor-related centers, and the associated electronic response of ZnO microparticles.

AI.tldr: 该文用变温EPR谱揭示N2与空气退火对ZnO微米颗粒顺磁缺陷的影响：N2退火产生Zni、VO+和浅施主中心，空气退火则出现Zni、VO+和与Hi相关中心；各中心在5–297 K行为差异明显。
AI.motivation: ZnO中缺陷类型与退火气氛的关系尚不清楚，尤其缺乏对顺磁中心温度依赖行为的系统研究，因此需明确退火气氛如何调控缺陷种群及电子响应。
AI.method: 对N2和空气气氛高温退火的ZnO微米颗粒进行变温（5–297 K）EPR测量，并结合EPR谱模拟分辨各顺磁中心（Zni、VO+、浅施主、Hi相关），同时分析腔体Q因子的温度变化。
AI.result: N2退火样品含Zni、VO+与浅施主中心，空气退火样品含Zni、VO+与Hi相关中心；浅施主和Hi信号在约50 K以下迅速猝灭，Zni呈非单调温度依赖；VO+信号持续至室温并随温度增强，符合涉及深氧空位态的施主缺陷间电荷再分布；两种样品的Q因子均随温度升高而下降，表明微波损耗随气氛改变。
AI.conclusion: 退火气氛可控制ZnO微米颗粒的顺磁缺陷种群、施主相关中心的温度依赖以及相应的电子响应，变温EPR是表征此类缺陷动力学的有效手段。

title: Momentum-selective graphene spectroscopy of moiré excitons
summary: Far-field photoluminescence probes only the light-cone corner of an exciton's momentum content, whereas energy transfer to nearby graphene integrates in-plane momenta up to the inverse spacer thickness $1/z$. For a WSe$_2$/MoSe$_2$ heterobilayer we build the transition polarization $\bm{P}_n(\qv)$ of each localized moiré exciton from the registry-dependent vector dipole texture and use each $\bm{P}_n$ for both baths. The two baths rank the states differently: the graphene-rate ratios differ from the optical ones, their ordering inverts with spacer thickness, and the distance exponents at $z=10$\,nm spread by more than two units. These ratios are independent of the transition-dipole prefactor. Within the $C_3$-symmetric leading-harmonic model the chiral $p_+$ and $d_-$ states are also dark at normal incidence yet transfer to graphene at rates comparable to the bright ground state. Their graphene rate depends on the sign of the texture phase, a quantity invisible in far-field emission, which we determine from first principles. In a device this prediction requires a splitting, larger than the symmetry-breaking mixing, that protects the chiral partners. Graphene proximity thus acts as a momentum-selective near-field probe of moiré excitons, and we propose its use as a practical spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 该文以WSe2/MoSe2莫尔激子的跃迁偏振为桥梁，比较远场发光(光锥受限)与石墨烯能量转移(动量积分至1/z)两种探测，展示二者对同一批莫尔激子态的排序与标度可截然不同，并提出石墨烯作为动量选择性近场探针。
AI.motivation: 远场光致发光只能探测激子动量空间中光锥角落，无法反映面内大动量的跃迁信息；而石墨烯能量转移可积分为1/z以内的面内动量。作者希望用同一跃迁偏振同时在两种探测通道中计算比较，揭示远场"看不见"的莫尔激子信息，并检验能否把石墨烯邻近效应用作动量选择性近场谱学。
AI.method: 为WSe2/MoSe2异质双层中每个局域莫尔激子，基于配准依赖的矢量偶极纹理构建跃迁偏振P_n(q)；将同一P_n分别代入远场发光与石墨烯能量转移两个通道，计算各态石墨烯转移率、与光学率的比值、随间隔层厚度z的排序与距离指数。采用C3对称的领头谐波模型分析手性p+、d-态在正入射下的暗态行为及其向石墨烯的转移率，并依赖纹理相位符号（由第一性原理确定）。
AI.result: 两种通道对激子态的排序不同：石墨烯率比值与光学比值不相等，且随间隔层厚度发生次序反转；在z=10 nm处距离指数相差超过2个单位；这些比值不依赖跃迁偶极前因子。C3领头谐波模型中，手性p+与d-态在正入射下为暗态，但向石墨烯的转移率可与亮的基态相当，且其石墨烯率依赖纹理相位的符号——这是远场发声中不可见的量，作者由第一性原理确定。
AI.conclusion: 石墨烯邻近效应可作为莫尔激子的动量选择性近场探针，作者建议将其发展为实用谱学手段；该预言在器件中需要具备大于对称破缺混合的分裂来保护手性伙伴态。

title: Deep Scientific Reasoning under Physical Constraints: Structure-Aware Spectrum Prediction
comment: Published in ICML 2026. Code and data are available on the project page: https://yingheng-wang.com/DeepSciReasoner
summary: Structured scientific spectra encode rich physical information while obeying hard constraints, such as conservation laws and characteristic spectral geometry. Accurate prediction of these spectra is central to materials discovery, yet existing methods often treat them as unconstrained sequences and therefore fail to enforce the underlying physical structure. Taking electronic density of states (eDOS) as the prototypical example, we introduce DeepSciReasoner, a general paradigm for predicting scientific spectra under physical constraints. The framework combines structure-aware spectrum decoding with constraint-preserving physical reasoning, allowing predictions to capture rich spectral structure while respecting the underlying physics. We evaluate DeepSciReasoner on eDOS, phonon density of states (phDOS), X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES), and Raman spectra, where it substantially improves prediction accuracy while maintaining physical consistency. These results establish DeepSciReasoner as a reusable blueprint for structured scientific spectrum prediction under hard physical constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepSciReasoner通用范式，将科学谱（如eDOS、phDOS、XANES、Raman）预测视为受物理约束的结构化预测问题，结合结构感知解码与保约束物理推理，在提升精度的同时保持物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 科学谱含有丰富物理信息并服从守恒律与特征谱几何等硬约束，但现有方法多将其当作无约束序列预测，无法保证物理结构，限制了准确性与可用性。
AI.method: 以电子态密度（eDOS）为原型，设计结构感知的谱解码（structure-aware spectrum decoding）与保约束的物理推理（constraint-preserving physical reasoning）相结合的框架。
AI.result: 在eDOS、声子态密度（phDOS）、XANES与拉曼谱四类任务上，显著提升预测精度，同时保持物理一致性。
AI.conclusion: DeepSciReasoner可作为硬物理约束下结构化科学谱预测的可复用范式，适用于多类谱学任务。

title: TCSP3.0: Template-Based Crystal Structure Prediction with Coefficient-Preserving Element Substitution and Structural Diversity
summary: Template-based crystal structure prediction (CSP) transfers a known crystal structure to a new composition by element substitution, so its accuracy depends on retrieving suitable templates, mapping elements and ranking the resulting candidates correctly. Auditing the original TCSP2.0 implementation on the T180 benchmark, we found that 469 of its 2,347 selected structures (20%) have the wrong composition, caused by element mappings that ignore stoichiometric coefficients and by sequential text substitution that cascades or corrupts element symbols. We propose TCSP3.0, which enforces coefficient-preserving mappings, substitutes species simultaneously on parsed structures and validates every candidate's composition and cell. It further adds periodic-number retrieval, soft oxidation-state evidence, radius-compatibility scoring, structural deduplication, and ORB-v3 machine-learning-potential relaxation and energy ranking of its candidates, as used by deep generative CSP baselines. TCSP3.0 achieves Top-1 and Top-20 match rates of 72.2% and 90.6% on T180, compared with 28.3% and 45.6% for TCSP2.0, and a Top-20 match rate of 74.0% on a new 800-target benchmark (T800). On T180 it also outperforms PNcsp+ and deep generative models CrystalFlow and MaskGXT (Top-1 72.2% versus at most 63.9%). Even without relaxation, TCSP3.0 reaches 67.8% at Top-1 and 90.6% at Top-20 in a median of 28 s per target on two CPU cores, about ten times faster than CrystalFlow. Paired ten-arm ablations on T180 and T800 show that most of the improvement comes from the correctness fixes; structural deduplication significantly improves the Top-5 match rate, embedding-based retrieval is required for coverage, and the remaining scoring features have small or null effects.

AI.tldr: 提出 TCSP3.0，修复原 TCSP2.0 的元素映射与替换错误并加入检索、评分、去重和 MLIP 弛豫，在 T180 上 Top-1/Top-20 达 72.2%/90.6%（原为 28.3%/45.6%）。
AI.motivation: 模板基晶体结构预测（TCSP）依赖模板检索、元素映射与候选排序，而审计 TCSP2.0 发现 T180 上 2347 个选中结构中有 469 个（20%）组分错误，源于忽略化学计量系数的映射以及顺序文本替换导致的符号级联/损坏，因此需要修正正确性并提升性能。
AI.method: TCSP3.0：强制保留系数的元素映射；在解析后的结构上同时替换物种；对每个候选校验组分与晶胞；新增周期序数检索、软氧化态证据、半径相容性评分、结构去重；并用 ORB-v3 机器学习势弛豫与能量排序（与深度生成式 CSP 基线一致）。
AI.result: T180 上 Top-1/Top-20 匹配率 72.2%/90.6%（TCSP2.0 为 28.3%/45.6%）；新基准 T800 上 Top-20 达 74.0%；T180 上优于 PNcsp+ 与 CrystalFlow、MaskGXT（Top-1 72.2% vs 最高 63.9%）。无弛豫时 Top-1 67.8%、Top-20 90.6%，双核 CPU 中位 28 秒/目标，约比 CrystalFlow 快十倍。
AI.conclusion: T180/T800 上的十组配对消融表明提升主要来自正确性修复；结构去重显著提升 Top-5，嵌入检索对覆盖率必不可少，其余评分特征影响较小或无影响。

title: Jensen-Mercer two-sided bounds for entropy production rate
summary: Bounds on entropy production convert limited observations into constraints on hidden dissipation. The Jensen bound expresses a lower bound on the total and subsystem entropy production rates of continuous stochastic systems in terms of mean coordinate rates alone. We show that the same convexity structure yields a complementary upper bound, inspired by Mercer's reflection inequality. For the quadratic entropy-production functional of overdamped Langevin dynamics, Mercer's reflection inequality is identical to the sharp Bhatia-Davis variance bound and coincides with the convex dual of the smallest affine majorant of the functional over the range of the local current. The two bounds yield a two-sided sandwich controlled solely by the mean drift and the extrema of the current, organized into a hierarchy of optimal bounds in which each further observation tightens the ceiling. The thermodynamic uncertainty relation supplies an independent fluctuation floor. We also treat position-dependent diffusion, underdamped dynamics and the tilted periodic potential, for which the weak-barrier series is obtained in closed form and the strong-barrier regime is solved asymptotically. We check the bounds numerically on the Brownian motor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出与Jensen下界互补的熵产上界，用均值漂移与流极值给出双向“三明治”夹逼，并建立最优界层级。
AI.motivation: 熵产界能把有限观测转化为对隐藏耗散的约束，但已有Jensen界只给下界，缺少仅由平均坐标速率控制的配套上界。
AI.method: 借鉴Mercer反射不等式，对过阻尼Langevin的二次熵产泛函构造凸对偶，证明其与Bhatia-Davis方差界及泛函在局域流范围上最小仿射优控函数等价；再结合热力学不确定关系作为独立涨落下限，并推广到位置依赖扩散、欠阻尼动力学与倾斜周期势。
AI.result: 得到仅依赖平均漂移与流极值的双侧夹逼，形成随观测增多而收紧的界层级；倾斜周期势弱垒级数有闭式，强垒情形渐近求解，并在布朗马达上做了数值验证。
AI.conclusion: Jensen型凸性结构同样可导出紧的熵产上界，与下界及TUR构成完整约束框架。

title: Field misalignment effect on the in-plane magnetoresistance in the high-temperature superconductor FeSe/SrTiO3
summary: The azimuthal angular dependence of the in-plane magnetoresistance provides a powerful probe for detecting rotational symmetry breaking in superconductors, which has significant implications for understanding the superconducting pairing symmetry and the intertwined orders. However, in two-dimensional or layered superconductors with strong anisotropy between in-plane and out-of-plane critical fields, measuring the in-plane magnetoresistance is particularly challenging as it is extremely sensitive to the field misalignment. Here we perform systematic electrical transport measurements on ultrathin FeSe films grown on SrTiO3 substrates. By remounting the same FeSe film to change the field misalignment, two qualitatively different angular dependences of the in-plane magnetoresistance are observed in the superconducting transition region, indicating the extreme sensitivity of the measurement to field misalignment. The observed anisotropic in-plane magnetoresistance can be well captured by our geometric model considering the field misalignment effect. Our work provides a practical framework for disentangling the misalignment effect and investigating the in-plane rotational symmetry breaking in two-dimensional or layered superconductors.

AI.tldr: 通过在SrTiO3衬底上生长超薄FeSe薄膜并重新安装样品改变场失配角，揭示了面内磁阻角向依赖对场失配极其敏感，并用几何模型成功解释了观测到的各向异性。
AI.motivation: 面内磁阻的角向依赖是探测超导旋转对称性破缺的有力手段，但二维/层状超导体中面内与面外临界场差异大，测量对面内场失配极度敏感，难以区分本征信号与失配伪影。
AI.method: 对生长在SrTiO3上的超薄FeSe薄膜进行系统电输运测量；通过重新安装同一薄膜以改变场失配角，比较超导转变区面内磁阻的角向依赖；建立考虑场失配效应的几何模型进行拟合。
AI.result: 同一FeSe薄膜在不同安装方式下表现出两种定性不同的面内磁阻角向依赖；该各向异性可由几何失配模型很好地定量描述。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了区分场失配效应与本征面内旋转对称性破缺的实用框架，为二维/层状超导体的相关研究提供指导。

title: Spin and Charge Photocurrents from Electric-Magnetic Dipole Interference in Centrosymmetric Crystals
summary: A common view regarding even-order nonlinear optical (NLO) effects, such as second-harmonic generation and the bulk photovoltaic effect, is that the breaking of inversion symmetry is necessary. However, this view relies on the assumption that light interacts with materials solely through its electric field. Here, we demonstrate that interference between the electric and magnetic components of the same light field can induce even-order NLO effects even in centrosymmetric materials. Using charge and spin photocurrents as prototypical examples, we present a unified microscopic theory showing how such electric-magnetic dipole interference (EMDI) drives NLO responses in inversion-symmetric crystals. Bilinear in both electric and magnetic fields, these responses scale linearly with light intensity. Combining symmetry analysis with first-principles calculations, we decompose the EMDI-induced photocurrents into shift-like and injection-like contributions and classify their dependence on crystal symmetry, time-reversal symmetry, and light polarization. Notably, we reveal that these EMDI-induced responses in centrosymmetric materials are weaker than conventional responses in non-centrosymmetric materials roughly by a factor of fine structure constant $α\approx [10^{-3}\text{--}10^{-2}] $. Nevertheless, they remain well within experimental reach. Our work thus unlocks NLO functionalities in centrosymmetric materials for e.g., materials characterization, photonics and optoelectronics. This is vital given that many functionally importantly materials, such as cubic Si and cubic $\mathrm{SrTiO_3}$, possess inversion symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在中心对称材料中，光场的电场与磁场分量之间的干涉（EMDI）可诱导偶数阶非线性光学效应（如电荷与自旋光电流），无需反演对称破缺，且响应强度约为常规非中心对称材料的细结构常数倍（10⁻³–10⁻²），但仍在实验可及范围。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为二次谐波产生、体光伏效应等偶数阶非线性光学效应必须依赖反演对称破缺，但这一观点建立在光仅通过电场与材料相互作用的假设之上。作者希望突破此限制，为立方Si、立方SrTiO₃等本征中心对称的重要功能材料开启非线性光学功能。
AI.method: 建立统一的微观理论，考虑光场电场与磁场的偶极干涉（EMDI），以电荷光电流与自旋光电流为原型示例；结合对称性分析与第一性原理计算，将EMDI诱导的光电流分解为shift型与injection型贡献，并按其依赖晶体对称性、时间反演对称性与光偏振的方式进行归类。
AI.result: EMDI诱导的响应在电场与磁场双线性下，随光强线性增长；在中心对称材料中该类响应比非中心对称材料的常规响应弱约细结构常数α≈10⁻³–10⁻²倍，但仍处于实验可探测范围。
AI.conclusion: 反演对称并非偶数阶非线性光学效应的必要条件，电场-磁场干涉可在中心对称晶体中驱动可观测的非线性响应。该工作为中心对称材料在材料表征、光子学与光电子学中的非线性光学应用开辟了新途径。

title: Tuning from intrinsic to disorder-dominated quantum states in a kagome antiferromagnet
summary: The spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet (AFM) provides a paradigmatic platform for realizing quantum spin-liquid (QSL) and magnetization-plateau states. Experimental progress, however, has been hindered by structural disorder, whose effects on these quantum states remain elusive. A key experimental challenge is therefore to connect intrinsic and disorder-dominated regimes through controlled disorder and identify emergent degrees of freedom associated with disorder. Here we introduce controlled point defects through electron irradiation into the spin-1/2 kagome AFM YCu3(OH)6.5Br2.5 (YCOB) and track the resulting evolution of its low-energy magnetic states. High-field magnetic torque measurements reveal that the 1/9 and 1/3 magnetization plateaus are strongly suppressed by only ~0.05% irradiation-induced defects, demonstrating that these delicate quantum many-body states are extraordinarily fragile against dilute disorder. Moreover, the irradiation induces a sign reversal of the magnetic torque only at low temperatures and low fields, indicating the emergence of correlated defect-induced moments rather than isolated free spins. Remarkably, the characteristic scaling of the magnetic specific heat, absent in pristine YCOB, progressively emerges with increasing disorder. These findings establish dilute disorder as an effective tuning parameter that drives the kagome AFM from intrinsic quantum states toward a disorder-dominated regime. The contrasting responses further identify pristine YCOB as an exceptionally clean kagome AFM for accessing intrinsic quantum states.

AI.tldr: 通过电子辐照在kagome反铁磁体YCOB中引入约0.05%的点缺陷，发现1/9与1/3磁化平台被强烈抑制，并观测到缺陷诱导关联磁矩与磁比热标度行为的涌现，确立稀磁无序作为调控kagome量子态的有效参数。
AI.motivation: 自旋1/2 kagome海森堡反铁磁体是研究量子自旋液体和磁化平台的理想平台，但结构无序严重阻碍实验进展，且无序对这些量子态的影响尚不清楚。关键挑战在于通过可控无序连接本征区与无序主导区，并识别无序关联的新兴自由度。
AI.method: 采用电子辐照在YCu3(OH)6.5Br2.5(YCOB)中引入可控点缺陷，结合高场磁力矩测量与磁比热测量，追踪低能磁态随无序浓度的演化。
AI.result: 仅约0.05%的辐照缺陷即强烈抑制1/9和1/3磁化平台，表明这些量子多体态对稀磁无序极其脆弱；辐照在低温低场下引起磁力矩符号反转，指示关联缺陷磁矩而非孤立自由自旋；随无序增加，原始样品中缺失的特征磁比热标度行为逐渐显现。
AI.conclusion: 稀磁无序可作为有效调控参数，驱动kagome反铁磁体从本征量子态转向无序主导区；相反响应对比表明原始YCOB是研究本征量子态的极洁净kagome反铁磁体。

title: Andreev Reflection at a Graphene Normal-Superconductor Interface: A Lattice-Continuum Comparison
summary:
We compare quadratic continuum and nearest-neighbour tight-binding models of Andreev reflection at a clean graphene normal-superconductor interface. For abrupt changes in chemical potential and pairing potential, with unchanged hopping, the lattice model yields four independent boundary conditions. Its reflection probabilities agree with independent Kwant calculations to numerical precision for the channels examined.
  We investigate trigonal warping and its effect on the relation between momentum and group velocity. For $(μ_N,μ_S,Δ_0,E)/t_0=(0.5,1,0.1,0.05)$, the Andreev-reflection probability for the $ξ=+1$ valley peaks at $19.9^\circ$ in the lattice model, versus $3.4^\circ$ in the quadratic continuum model.
