AI.conclusion: 结果建立了超越局域流体力学的集体声子迁移率与热传导之间的微观联系。

title: Temperature-dependent magnetic properties of the antiferromagnet Mn$_2$Au
comment: 10 pages main, 4 figures. 3 pages SI, 2 figures
summary: Mn$_2$Au is one of the most promising materials for antiferromagnetic spintronics due to its high Néel temperature, moderate anisotropy, layered spin structure allowing current induced spin-orbit-torques, and ultrafast spin dynamics. Further understanding and control of the magnetic order in Mn$_2$Au for ultrafast spintronics applications via ultrashort electric/optical means requires accurate understanding of how its magnetic properties depend on temperature. Here we present atomistic spin dynamics simulations of the temperature-dependent macroscopic magnetic properties of Mn$_2$Au single crystals. We introduce a spin Hamiltonian based on previous ab initio calculations which produces temperature-dependent scaling of the anisotropy constants with magnetisation consistent with Zener-Akulov-Callen-Callen power laws. The calculated temperature dependence of exchange stiffness follows a scaling law with magnetisation of $m^{1.83}_e$ , and predicts a temperature-dependent domain wall width that agrees very well with direct simulation. Our model provides an understanding of temperature-dependent magnetic properties of Mn$_2$Au that enables large-scale simulation of the working conditions of spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过原子尺度自旋动力学模拟，基于第一性原理构建Mn₂Au的自旋哈密顿量，系统研究了其宏观磁学性质（各向异性、交换刚度、畴壁宽度）的温度依赖关系。
AI.motivation: Mn₂Au因高奈尔温度、适中各向异性与超快自旋动力学而成为反铁磁自旋电子学的候选材料；但要实现超快电/光调控，需准确理解其磁学性质随温度的变化。
AI.method: 构建基于既往从头计算的自旋哈密顿量，进行原子尺度自旋动力学模拟，计算Mn₂Au单晶的温度依赖宏观磁性质，并检验各向异性常数随磁化强度的标度与交换刚度标度。
AI.result: 各向异性常数随磁化的温度标度符合Zener-Akulov-Callen-Callen幂律；交换刚度满足m_e^1.83的标度律；计算得到的畴壁宽度温度依赖与直接模拟高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该模型揭示了Mn₂Au温度依赖磁学性质的物理机制，可支撑自旋电子器件工作条件的大尺度模拟。

title: Optical Thermometry in Monolayer WS2: Raman and Photoluminescence Spectroscopy from 5 K to 1273 K
summary: Reliable temperature measurement is essential for characterizing and engineering two-dimensional (2D) semiconductor devices, yet optical thermometry of 2D materials has so far been demonstrated only over narrow temperature windows spanning a few hundred kelvin. Here, we establish a comprehensive optical thermometry framework for monolayer WS2 from 5~K to 1273~K. We show that: (i) the out-of-plane A1g Raman mode shifts linearly with temperature above 100~K, with a slope of -0.0138 cm^{-1}/K in non-encapsulated WS2 (fitted over 298-1223~K) and a measurably smaller slope of -0.0121 cm^{-1}/K in an hBN-encapsulated sample (fitted over 100-1273~K); (ii) photoluminescence spectra measured over the same 5--1273~K range provide an independent optical indicator of the temperature: the neutral-exciton emission redshifts continuously with temperature and is well described by the semi-empirical Pässler model. The two indicators probe distinct physical mechanisms, lattice anharmonicity and bandgap renormalization, and together provide contact-free thermometry for monolayer WS2 from 5~K to 1273~K, an approach applicable to 2D semiconductors more broadly.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了覆盖5 K至1273 K的单层WS2综合光学测温框架，利用A1g拉曼模线性温漂和中性命激子发光红移两种独立指标实现非接触测温。
AI.motivation: 二维半导体器件的表征与工程需要可靠的温度测量，但现有二维材料光学测温仅在几百开尔的窄温区内得到验证，缺乏宽温域、多指标交叉验证的手段。
AI.method: 对单层WS2在5–1273 K范围内进行变温拉曼与光致发光测量：提取面外A1g模随温度的变化斜率，并比较未封装与hBN封装样品的差异；同时拟合中性命激子发光随温度的红移，采用半经验Pässler模型描述。
AI.result: A1g模在100 K以上线性漂移，未封装样品斜率-0.0138 cm⁻¹/K（298–1223 K拟合），hBN封装样品为-0.0121 cm⁻¹/K（100–1273 K拟合）；中性命激子发光随温度连续红移，可由Pässler模型很好描述。
AI.conclusion: 拉曼（晶格非谐性）与发光（带隙重整化）两种指标探测不同物理机制，联合构成5–1273 K范围的非接触测温方案，可推广至更广泛的二维半导体材料。

title: Control of the Electronic and Atomic Structure of the Altermagnetic α-MnTe Surface via Substrate-Induced Surfactants
summary: Altermagnets are a novel class of materials with unique momentum dependent spin-polarization of the electronic band structure, which opens up new avenues for spintronic devices. Altermagnetic α-MnTe is particularly interesting for such applications due to its giant spin splitting and the persistence of altermagnetic order up to room temperature. Growth of thin films is, however, challenging and governed by interactions with the substrate. As a result, the surface of α-MnTe thin films exhibits very different atomic structures in dependence of the substrate material. Whereas on SrF2(111) an atomically clean, perfectly (2x2) reconstructed surface forms, on InP(111)A the MnTe surface is always InTe terminated due to super-segregation of In from the substrate to the surface. Most strikingly, the InTe surfactant layer displays a quasi-periodic dislocation network to accommodate the InTe/MnTe lattice mismatch. This leads to the emergence of distinct surface states in dependence of surface termination that strongly affect the electronic band structure at the surface as shown by angle resolved photoemission and tunneling spectroscopy. Thus, control and characterization of the atomic structure of the surface is fundamentally important for understanding the properties of altermagnets and provides room for engineering and tailoring of spin-polarized states in actual devices.

AI.tldr: 研究了α-MnTe薄膜表面原子结构随衬底变化的情况：SrF2(111)上形成干净(2x2)重构表面，InP(111)A上因In超偏析形成InTe终止层及准周期位错网络，并导致不同表面态显著影响表面电子能带结构。
AI.motivation: 交替磁体（altermagnets）具有动量依赖的自旋极化能带，为自旋电子器件提供新途径；α-MnTe因巨大自旋劈裂和室温以上交替磁序而备受关注，但薄膜生长受衬底相互作用制约，表面结构控制与理解对器件应用至关重要。
AI.method: 在不同衬底（SrF2(111)、InP(111)A）上生长α-MnTe薄膜，表征表面原子结构；结合角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）与隧穿谱研究表面终止相关的表面态及电子能带结构。
AI.result: SrF2(111)上获得原子级洁净、完美(2x2)重构表面；InP(111)A上因In从衬底超偏析始终为InTe终止，且InTe表面活性层形成准周期位错网络以缓解晶格失配。不同表面终止产生不同表面态，强烈影响表面电子能带结构。
AI.conclusion: 表面原子结构的控制与表征是理解交替磁体性质的基础，并为实际器件中自旋极化态的设计与调控提供空间。

title: Flexural Altermagnetism
summary: We establish flexural deformation as a versatile route for engineering altermagnetism in two-dimensional collinear antiferromagnets. By tailoring the flexure, we selectively break different symmetries to realize altermagnetic states with distinct wave symmetries and reverse their spin splitting. A tight-binding model and first-principles calculations for monolayer MnPS3 demonstrate d- and i-wave states and a switchable transverse spin current in the d-wave state.

AI.tldr: 通过弯曲(挠曲变形)打破二维共线反铁磁体中的不同对称性，可在单层MnPS₃中实现具有d波、i波等不同波对称性的交错磁态，并实现自旋劈裂翻转与可切换的横向自旋流。
AI.motivation: 交错磁(altermagnetism)在二维共线反铁磁体中的实现与调控缺乏通用、可逆且多样的手段；作者希望找到一种能选择性打破对称性、从而获得多种波对称交错磁态的调控途径。
AI.method: 以挠曲变形(flexural deformation)作为调控手段，通过定制弯曲方式选择性破坏不同对称性；结合紧束缚模型与单层MnPS₃的第一性原理计算进行验证。
AI.result: 在单层MnPS₃中获得d波与i波交错磁态，实现自旋劈裂的翻转，并在d波态中实现可切换的横向自旋流。
AI.conclusion: 挠曲变形是一种通用且灵活的二维共线反铁磁体中工程化交错磁的策略，可赋予交错磁态多样的波对称性并实现自旋输运的可控切换。

title: High-Q, high-power spin Hall nano-oscillators with thick NiFe layers enabled by SiC substrates
summary: Spin Hall nano-oscillators (SHNOs) are nanoscale microwave sources with potential applications in local spin excitation, neuromorphic computing, and oscillator-based Ising machines. Further improvements in output power and coherence are essential for these applications, and increasing the thickness of the ferromagnetic layer offers a promising route toward this goal. However, this comes at the cost of higher drive currents, which increase Joule heating and can degrade device performance. Here, we show that this bottleneck can be overcome by SiC substrates. By comparing otherwise identical W/NiFe nanoconstriction SHNOs on Al2O3, Si, and SiC, we find that the high thermal conductivity of SiC enables stable auto-oscillations in NiFe layers as thick as 10 nm, while the optimum performance occurs at 7 nm. The best SiC device reaches an average output power of 13.1 pW and a mean quality factor of Q = 23,000, representing the highest reported simultaneous output power and coherence for a single free-running SHNO. These results establish SiC and thermal substrate engineering as a route to thick-ferromagnet spintronic oscillators for coherent microwave generation in nanoscale devices.

AI.tldr: 通过在SiC衬底上进行热学工程，W/NiFe纳米收缩型自旋霍尔纳米振荡器（SHNO）可在10 nm厚NiFe下稳定自激振荡，7 nm时性能最优，最佳器件输出功率13.1 pW、Q≈23,000，为单自由运行SHNO同时报道的最高功率与相干性。
AI.motivation: SHNO在局域自旋激发、类脑计算与振荡器伊辛机中有应用前景，但需提升输出功率与相干性。加厚铁磁层是有效途径，却带来更高驱动电流、焦耳热与器件退化问题。
AI.method: 对比Al2O3、Si、SiC三种衬底上完全相同的W/NiFe纳米收缩SHNO，利用SiC高导热性抑制焦耳热，系统研究NiFe厚度对自激振荡稳定性与性能的影响。
AI.result: SiC上NiFe厚度可达10 nm仍保持稳定自激振荡，最优厚度为7 nm；最佳器件平均输出功率13.1 pW，平均品质因子Q=23,000，为单一自由运行SHNO中同时报道的最高功率与相干性组合。
AI.conclusion: SiC衬底与热学衬底工程是实现厚铁磁层自旋电子振荡器、面向纳米器件相干微波产生的可行路线。

title: Impact of organic spacer cations on the light and thermal stability of two-dimensional lead halide perovskites
summary: Long-term stability remains a critical challenge limiting the photovoltaic and optoelectronic applications of two-dimensional lead halide perovskites. In these materials, the choice of the organic spacer plays a key role not only in enhancing environmental stability, but also in determining their structural characteristics and carrier dynamics. Here, we present an environmental photo- and thermal-stability analysis of BA2PbI4 and PEA2PbI4 two-dimensional lead halide perovskites by means of confocal micro-Raman and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy techniques. We have investigated two different organic spacers, n-butylammonium (BA) and 2-phenylethylammonium (PEA), which provide comparable room-temperature luminescence in freshly exfoliated perovskite nanoflakes and degrade similarly through the removal of organic components and fast crystal phase decomposition into PbI2 and Pb0. However, we observed that the PEA organic cation significantly improves crystal morphology and suppresses lattice defects, resulting in slower degradation and enhanced resistance to light and thermal stress under ambient conditions. Our findings indicate that structural and chemical engineering, along with surface passivation and encapsulation strategies, are essential for achieving long-term stability in two-dimensional halide perovskite devices. Nevertheless, optimizing the balance between stability and device performance remains a critical consideration.

AI.tldr: 本文对比BA2PbI4与PEA2PbI4两种二维铅卤钙钛矿的光/热环境稳定性，发现PEA阳离子可改善晶体形貌、抑制晶格缺陷，从而减缓降解、提升抗光热应力能力。
AI.motivation: 二维铅卤钙钛矿的长期稳定性是限制其光伏与光电器件应用的关键瓶颈，而有机间隔阳离子的选择同时影响环境稳定性、结构特征与载流子动力学，亟需明确不同间隔阳离子对降解行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用共聚焦微区拉曼光谱与X射线光电子能谱（XPS），对BA2PbI4和PEA2PbI4（BA=正丁基铵，PEA=2-苯乙基铵）纳米片在环境条件下的光稳定性和热稳定性进行对比分析，追踪有机组分去除与晶相分解过程。
AI.result: 新鲜剥离的两种钙钛矿纳米片室温发光性能相当，且均通过有机组分流失并快速分解为PbI2和Pb0而降解；但PEA阳离子显著改善晶体形貌、抑制晶格缺陷，使降解更慢，在环境条件下对光和热应力具有更强抵抗力。
AI.conclusion: 有机间隔阳离子的结构调控可有效提升二维钙钛矿稳定性；实现长期稳定仍需结合结构/化学工程、表面钝化与封装策略，同时须权衡稳定性与器件性能之间的平衡。

title: Orbital-selective correlations in kagome flat bands of Co$_3$Sn$_2$S$_2$
summary: Geometrical flat bands provide an ideal platform for studying electronic correlations and quantum-geometric effects. Although the ferromagnetic Weyl semimetal \CoSnS is generally considered a moderately correlated system, recent spectroscopy experiments have revealed a flat-band feature near the Fermi level ($\EF$) that is absent in conventional density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Using DFT plus dynamical mean-field theory and a minimal kagome model, we show that this feature arises not from heavy-fermion-like dynamical band renormalization, but from the shifting of a $d_{x^2-y^2}$ dominated geometrical kagome flat band toward $\EF$ driven by orbital- and spin-dependent self-energies. The relocated flat band enhances the local Berry curvature near $\EF$, resulting in a strongly energy-dependent anomalous Hall conductivity and a giant anomalous Nernst effect. Our findings establish an orbital-selective correlation mechanism for positioning geometrical flat bands at $\EF$, and propose anomalous thermoelectric transport as a sensitive probe of flat band induced topology.

AI.tldr: 该文通过DFT+DMFT与最小kagome模型揭示，Co3Sn2S2近费米面的平带并非重费米子式动力学重正化，而是轨道/自旋依赖自能驱动的几何kagome平带位移，并增强Berry曲率产生巨大反常能斯特效应。
AI.motivation: 铁磁Weyl半金属Co3Sn2S2通常被视为中等关联体系，但近期谱学实验观察到常规DFT无法解释的近费米面平带特征，其物理起源不明。
AI.method: 采用DFT+动力学平均场理论（DMFT）结合最小kagome模型，分析轨道与自旋分辨自能对能带位置的影响。
AI.result: 发现该平带源于d_{x^2-y^2}主导的几何kagome平带在自能作用下移向费米能级；位移后的平带增强近费米面局域Berry曲率，导致强能量依赖的反常霍尔电导和巨大反常能斯特效应。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种将几何平带定位到费米能级的轨道选择性关联机制，并指出反常热电输运可作为平带诱导拓扑敏感探测手段。

title: Higher-harmonic spin-wave excitation by a superconducting antenna with vortices
summary: The interaction between superconductivity and magnetism provides new routes for controlling nonlinear excitations in hybrid systems. While dc-driven Abrikosov vortices (fluxons) are known to interact with spin waves, the ability of confined, nearly harmonic vortex oscillations to generate higher-frequency spin-wave modes remains unexplored. Here, by combining time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau modeling with spectral analysis of the microwave near field, we demonstrate higher-harmonic spin-wave excitation driven by a superconducting microstrip antenna in the Shubnikov phase. Unlike conventional harmonic-generation mechanisms associated with nonlinear magnetization dynamics, the magnetic layer remains a linear receiver, whereas the superconducting antenna generates the nonlinear microwave field. We show that nearly sinusoidal vortex motion and the accompanying redistribution of superconducting screening currents produce higher harmonics that couple to spin-wave modes. This response arises from spatial-to-temporal transduction, whereby harmonic vortex motion and the associated redistribution of screening currents convert a spatially nonuniform magnetic-field profile into higher temporal harmonics. Magnetic flux quanta thus act as active nonlinear elements for frequency conversion, extending the accessible spin-wave frequency range in superconducting--magnonic hybrids.

AI.tldr: 该文理论研究表明，超导微带天线中的近简谐涡旋运动可将空间非均匀磁场分布转换为高频谐波，从而以纯线性磁层激发高次谐波自旋波。
AI.motivation: 超导与磁性杂化体系为调控非线性激发提供新途径。虽已知直流驱动的Abrikosov涡旋可影响自旋波，但受限的近简谐涡旋振荡能否产生高次谐波自旋波模式尚属空白。
AI.method: 结合含时Ginzburg–Landau模型与微波近场谱分析，研究Shubnikov相中超导微带天线的涡旋振荡及其辐射谐波，并考察其与自旋波模式的耦合。
AI.result: 发现近正弦涡旋运动及屏蔽电流重分布产生高次谐波并耦合至自旋波模式；与常规非线性磁化谐波机制不同，磁层仍为线性接收端，非线性微波场由超导天线产生。
AI.conclusion: 该响应源于"空间—时间转导"：谐波涡旋运动与屏蔽电流重分布将空间非均匀磁场转化为时间高次谐波。磁通量子因此成为主动的非线性频率转换元件，扩展了超导—磁振子杂化体系的可用自旋波频率范围。

title: Investigation of the Microstructural and Magnetic Properties of Ni on GeSn Layers
summary: Thermal processing of nickel (Ni) layers on germanium-tin (GeSn) can strongly modify the Ni film and the Ni/GeSn interface within a restricted thermal budget; however, the influence of GeSn crystalline quality on Ni-Ge-Sn interfacial evolution and the magnetic response of the Ni layer remains incompletely understood. Here, Ni (15~nm)/Ge$_{1-x}$Sn$_x$/Ge/Gd$_2$O$_3$/Si(111) heterostructures ($x = 0.08$ and $0.10$) were investigated following rapid thermal annealing at 573 and 973~K for 10~s using X-ray diffraction, pole-figure analysis, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy depth profiling, and temperature- and field-dependent magnetization measurements. Annealing at 573~K preserves the crystallographic texture of Ge$_{0.92}$Sn$_{0.08}$, whereas Ge$_{0.90}$Sn$_{0.10}$ exhibits microtwin formation and reduced structural integrity. Annealing at 973~K, employed as a severe upper-bound thermal reference, causes extensive structural degradation in both heterostructures, with substantially greater deterioration in the higher-Sn sample. XPS depth profiling reveals progressive Ni-Ge-Sn intermixing accompanied by pronounced Sn surface segregation with increasing annealing temperature. Magnetization measurements show coexisting ferromagnetic and superparamagnetic contributions in the as-deposited and 573~K samples, whereas annealing at 973~K strongly suppresses the ferromagnetic response, producing highly unsaturated $M(H)$ loops together with reduced saturation magnetization and coercivity. These magnetic changes are consistent with extensive interfacial alloying and dilution of the metallic Ni layer. This study establishes a direct correlation between GeSn crystalline quality, interfacial diffusion, and magnetic behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究Ni/GeSn异质结在不同温度快速热退火下的界面演化与磁性响应，揭示GeSn晶体质量、界面扩散与磁性的关联。
AI.motivation: Ni/GeSn热工艺会显著改变Ni薄膜及界面，但GeSn晶体质量对Ni-Ge-Sn界面演化及Ni层磁响应的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 制备Ni(15nm)/Ge1-xSnx/Ge/Gd2O3/Si(111)异质结（x=0.08、0.10），在573K和973K下快速热退火10s；采用XRD、极图分析、XPS深度剖析及变温/变场磁化测量进行表征。
AI.result: 573K退火保持Ge0.92Sn0.08的晶体织构，但Ge0.90Sn0.10出现微孪晶、结构完整性下降；973K下两者均严重退化，高Sn样品更差。XPS显示随退火温度升高Ni-Ge-Sn互扩散增强并伴明显Sn表面偏析。原态与573K样品存在铁磁与超顺磁共存，973K退火强烈抑制铁磁响应，M(H)回线高度不饱和，饱和磁化强度与矫顽力降低。
AI.conclusion: 磁性变化与界面合金化及金属Ni层稀释一致，建立了GeSn晶体质量、界面扩散与磁行为之间的直接关联。

title: Anomalous Mobility Enhancement in Restricted Geometries
summary: We investigate the effect of geometrical confinement on driven transport in anomalous media within the framework of the quenched trap model. The particle performs a biased random walk on a lattice, where quenched disorder introduces power-law distributed trapping times. We consider channels that are infinite along one direction and have a finite cross-section in the remaining $d-1$ directions. In the glassy regime, where $α=T/T_g<1$, we derive an analytical expression for the mean longitudinal displacement in the long-time and weak-force limits. We find the scaling $\langle x_\parallel(t)\rangle \propto F_\parallel^αt^αΩ^{-(1-α)}$, where $F_\parallel>0$ is the effective longitudinal force and $Ω$ is the number of sites in a transverse cross-section. Thus, the anomalous mobility is enhanced for narrower channels. Our analytical result applies to general Bravais lattices in $d$ dimensions with periodic transverse boundary conditions. Numerical simulations confirm the analytical predictions for different lattice geometries and show quantitative agreement even for channels with reflecting boundary conditions.

AI.tldr: 在淬火陷阱模型中研究几何限域对反常介质中驱动输运的影响，解析得到长时弱力极限下平均纵向位移满足 ⟨x∥(t)⟩ ∝ F∥^α t^α Ω^{-(1-α)}，表明通道越窄反常迁移率越强。
AI.motivation: 探索几何限域（有限横截面的通道）如何影响淬火无序介质中的驱动（偏置）输运，理解受限几何下的反常输运规律。
AI.method: 采用淬火陷阱模型，粒子在格点上做偏置随机游走，淬火无序给出幂律分布的陷阱时间；考虑沿一个方向无限延伸、其余 d-1 方向截面有限的通道，在玻璃态区（α=T/T_g<1）于长时与弱力极限下解析推导平均纵向位移，并适用于任意 Bravais 格点及周期横向边界条件；用数值模拟验证。
AI.result: 得到 ⟨x∥(t)⟩ ∝ F∥^α t^α Ω^{-(1-α)} 的标度关系，其中 F∥ 为有效纵向力、Ω 为横截面格点数；即窄通道中反常迁移率被增强。数值模拟在不同晶格几何下验证了解析预测，且对反射边界条件的通道也给出定量一致。
AI.conclusion: 几何限域会显著调制淬火无序介质中的驱动输运，反常迁移率随横截面减小而按 Ω^{-(1-α)} 增强；解析结果具有较广的普适性并获数值模拟支持。

title: Anisotropic magneto-elastic coupling in the quasi-2D Ising magnet Li$_2$FeSiO$_4$ and thermodynamic signature of low-energy orbital excitations
summary: The relevance of spin, lattice and orbital degrees of freedom in the quasi-2D Ising-like magnet Li$_2$FeSiO$_4$ is demonstrated by thermal expansion and specific heat measurements supported by numerical studies. By means of thermodynamic and Grüneisen analysis, we separate the orbital signatures and quantify the energy gap and its pressure dependence from the experimental data as $Δ\sim 300 - 350$ K and $\partial \ln Δ/\partial p_{\rm c} \approx -4.6$ %/GPa). Both values excellently agree with the theoretical DFT predictions. The thermal expansion anomalies associated with the onset of long-range magnetic order imply significant magneto-elastic coupling and are used to determine the anisotropic uniaxial strain dependencies of $T_{\rm N}$. They are dominated by the in-plane (i.e., $c$ axis) response $(\partial \ln{ T_{\rm N}} )/\partial p_{\rm c} \simeq 15$ %/GPa while the (negative) $a$ axis and (positive) out-of-plane ($b$ axis) pressure dependencies are much smaller. Short-range magnetic order extends well above $T_{\rm N}$ but is not driven by the same energy scale as $T_{\rm N}$ as evidenced by the observation of non-monotonic in-plane distortion, sign-change of the Grüneisen parameter, and failure of Grüneisen scaling.

AI.tldr: 通过热膨胀与比热测量结合数值计算，揭示准二维Ising磁体Li2FeSiO4中自旋、晶格与轨道自由度的关联，分离轨道信号并量化能隙及其压力依赖。
AI.motivation: 探究准二维Ising磁体Li2FeSiO4中自旋、晶格和轨道自由度的相对重要性，并厘清轨道能隙、磁弹性耦合与短程磁序之间的关系。
AI.method: 热膨胀与比热实验测量，辅以数值研究；采用热力学与Grüneisen分析分离轨道特征，并用DFT理论计算进行对照验证。
AI.result: 能隙Δ∼300–350 K，其压力依赖∂lnΔ/∂pc≈−4.6 %/GPa，与DFT预测高度一致；长程磁序起始处的热膨胀异常表明显著磁弹性耦合，TN的各向异性单轴应变依赖以面内(c轴)响应为主(≈15 %/GPa)，a轴(负)与b轴(正)响应小得多；短程磁序延伸至TN以上，但不由与TN相同的能量尺度驱动，表现为非单调面内畸变、Grüneisen参数变号及Grüneisen标度失效。
AI.conclusion: 轨道、自旋与晶格自由度在Li2FeSiO4中紧密耦合；轨道能隙及其压力依赖可由实验定量确定并与理论吻合，磁弹性耦合主导TN的各向异性压力响应，而短程磁序与长程序受不同能量尺度控制。

title: Direct observation of a spin-polarized surface Dirac gap in the antiferromagnetic topological insulator NdBi
summary: A gapped Dirac cone in antiferromagnetic topological insulators (AFM-TIs) is essential for realizing the quantized anomalous Hall effect, yet its intrinsic magnitude remains controversial. In the prototypical AFM-TI MnBi2Te4, however, the observed Dirac gap is significantly smaller than theoretical predictions or nearly absent, highlighting a long-standing discrepancy. Here we demonstrate that NdBi hosts a spin-polarized topological surface Dirac cone with a sizable gap of 17 meV at the Dirac point, in excellent agreement with density functional theory predictions (12 meV). This direct observation is enabled by high-resolution 7 eV laser-based spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, which unambiguously disentangles the spin-polarized surface Dirac cone from bulk-derived states. Furthermore, through temperature dependence and controlled surface contamination, we establish a direct linkage between surface magnetism and the Dirac gap, demonstrating that the gap opens only in the presence of surface magnetic order. These results provide definitive spectroscopic evidence for an intrinsic Dirac gap in AFM-TIs and establish NdBi as a model platform to resolve the long-standing discrepancy between experiment and theory in AFM-TIs.

AI.tldr: 利用高分辨7 eV激光自旋分辨ARPES，在反铁磁拓扑绝缘体NdBi中直接观测到17 meV的自旋极化表面狄拉克能隙，与DFT预测(12 meV)高度吻合，并证实能隙仅在表面磁有序存在时打开。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁拓扑绝缘体(AFM-TI)中狄拉克能隙是实现量子化反常霍尔效应的关键，但其本征大小长期存在争议：原型材料MnBi2Te4中观测到的能隙远小于理论预测甚至几乎不存在，实验与理论之间的长期矛盾亟待解决。
AI.method: 采用高分辨率7 eV激光基自旋分辨角分辨光电子能谱(spin-ARPES)，将自旋极化的表面狄拉克锥与体态来源的电子态明确区分开；并通过温度依赖测量与受控表面污染实验，考察表面磁性与能隙的关联。
AI.result: 在NdBi的狄拉克点处观测到约17 meV的可观能隙，与密度泛函理论预测的12 meV高度吻合；能隙仅在表面磁有序存在时打开，建立了表面磁性与狄拉克能隙之间的直接联系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为AFM-TI中本征狄拉克能隙提供了确定性的光谱学证据，并将NdBi确立为解决AFM-TI领域实验与理论长期分歧的模型平台。

title: Simultaneous suppression and temperature-driven crossover of particle-like and wave-like thermal transport in trigonal CsAg$_3$S$_2$
summary:
The simultaneous suppression of particle-like ($κ_p$ ) and wave-like ($κ_c$) thermal transport channels in crystalline materials remains a challenging problem, as reducing one channel can enhance the other. Here, we investigate the thermal transport in trigonal $P\Bar{3}m1$ CsAg$_3$S$_2$ using self-consistent phonon theory with cubic and quartic anharmonicity and the unified theory of thermal transport.
  Our calculations predict an ultralow lattice thermal conductivity of 0.222 W m$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$ at 300 K, featuring simultaneously low $κ_p$ and $κ_c$ with a weak temperature dependence of $\sim$T$^{-0.42}$, which deviates significantly from the conventional $\sim$T$^{-1}$ behavior. This simultaneous suppression arises from localized Cs modes, which enhance anharmonic scattering, and the softer Ag-S framework, which reduces phonon group velocities, together suppressing $κ_p$, in conjunction with sparse, well-separated high-frequency S-derived optical modes that suppress $κ_c$ by limiting the coherent coupling between the phonon modes. Furthermore, the dominant transport channel exhibits a temperature-dependent crossover, with $κ_p$ contributing $\sim$74 \% of total lattice thermal conductivity at 300~K and $κ_c$ contributing $\sim$63 \% at 700~K. Combining the ultralow thermal conductivity with electrical transport calculated within the momentum relaxation time approximation (MRTA), we obtain a $ZT$ of 1.28 for $n$-type doping at 700 K. The present work not only clarifies the microscopic mechanism of ultralow thermal conductivity in trigonal CsAg$_3$S$_2$ but also identifies the covalent M-Ch framework modification within the AM$_3$Ch$_2$ family of ternary chalcogenides as an additional tuning parameter for further reducing $κ_p$ within the bonding-hierarchy design principle.

AI.tldr: 通过自洽声子理论（含三、四阶非谐）与统一热输运理论，揭示三方 CsAg₃S₂ 中粒子型与波动型热输运通道同时被抑制，实现0.222 W/mK的超低晶格热导率及ZT=1.28。
AI.motivation: 晶态材料中粒子型(κp)与波动型(κc)热输运通道通常此消彼长，难以同时抑制，这是降低晶格热导率的核心难题。
AI.method: 采用含三阶与四阶非谐性的自洽声子理论结合统一热输运理论，计算 P3̄m1 CsAg₃S₂ 的热输运；电输运用 MRTA 计算以评估 ZT。
AI.result: 300 K 晶格热导率仅 0.222 W/mK，κp 与 κc 同时偏低，温度依赖约 T^-0.42（偏离常规 T^-1）。局域 Cs 振动增强非谐散射、较软的 Ag–S 骨架降低群速度共同压制 κp；稀疏且分离的高频 S 衍生光学模限制相干耦合从而压制 κc。主导通道随温度转变：300 K 时 κp 占~74%，700 K 时 κc 占~63%。n 型掺杂 700 K 下 ZT=1.28。
AI.conclusion: 阐明了 CsAg₃S₂ 超低热导率的微观机制，并提出 AM₃Ch₂ 家族中共价 M–Ch 骨架调控可作为在键合层级设计原则下进一步降低 κp 的额外调节参数。

title: Momentum-resolved thermodynamics and barrier-free order-parameter collapse in spin-orbit-coupled superconductors under a Zeeman field
summary: Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) can enhance the critical Zeeman field of clean superconductors beyond the Pauli limit. We develop a momentum decomposition of the zero-temperature free energy to investigate spin-singlet $s$-wave superconductors with general time-reversal-symmetric SOC. The SOC component perpendicular to the Zeeman field enhances the critical field and suppresses first-order features, whereas the parallel component favors Pauli-limited thermodynamic behavior. Applying this framework to Rashba superconductors and Ising superconductors with weak Rashba SOC, we identify the origin of the abrupt collapse of the superconducting order parameter at the critical field. Competing angular contributions produce a nearly flat free-energy landscape, allowing a barrier-free order-parameter collapse distinct from the conventional Pauli-limited first-order transition.

AI.tldr: 通过动量分解零温自由能，揭示SOC垂直/平行分量对自旋单态s波超导体临界场和相变性质的相反作用，并解释Rashba与Ising超导体中序参量在临界场的无势垒突变。（约80字）
AI.motivation: SOC可提升超导体临界Zeeman场至Pauli极限之上，但已有描述偏唯象，缺乏对各SOC分量作用机制及临界场处序参量骤降原因的微观理解。
AI.method: 提出零温自由能的动量分解方法，系统研究一般时间反演对称SOC下的自旋单态s波超导体，并应用于Rashba超导体及弱Rashba SOC的Ising超导体。
AI.result: 垂直Zeeman场的SOC分量提高临界场并抑制一阶特征；平行分量倾向于Pauli极限的热力学行为。竞争性角向贡献使自由能景观近乎平坦，导致序参量无势垒塌缩。
AI.conclusion: 临界场处的序参量突变源于动量空间不同角向贡献的竞争，是一种区别于常规Pauli极限一阶相变的新机制，为SOC超导体相变分类提供统一框架。

title: Zeeman-field-induced three-spin interactions and relativistic coupling to the scalar spin chirality
summary: Magnetic fields are commonly incorporated in atomistic spin models through the Zeeman energy of individual magnetic moments. Starting from a microscopic electronic Hamiltonian, we show that the Zeeman coupling of conduction electrons also generates field-linear three-spin interactions, the lowest-order corrections allowed by time-reversal symmetry. Using a Green-function expansion of the grand potential, we identify two classes of interactions. Isotropic terms of the form $(\mathbf S_i\cdot\mathbf S_j)(\mathbf S_k\cdot\mathbf B)$ exist without spin-orbit coupling, and their total strength obeys a sum rule involving the three-site electronic loop at the Fermi energy. Relativistic terms require spin-orbit coupling and include $\mathbf K_{ijk}\cdot\mathbf B,χ_{ijk}$, where $χ_{ijk}=\mathbf S_i\cdot(\mathbf S_j\times\mathbf S_k)$ is the scalar spin chirality. We show that this coupling is forbidden in the spin channel without spin-orbit coupling, whereas the orbital channel recovers the orbital-flux mechanism of Mott insulators. Exact diagonalization of the Hubbard trimer confirms the independence and additivity of both channels. For magnetic trimers in Rashba electron gases, we derive analytical expressions showing that $\mathbf K_{ijk}$ lies in-plane at first order in spin-orbit coupling but vanishes for $C_{3v}$-symmetric trimers, where an out-of-plane component emerges at second order. These interactions can shift magnetization-step fields and modify field-induced noncoplanarity. In the continuum limit, the chirality coupling splits skyrmions from antiskyrmions, while the relativistic terms generate a field-dependent Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文从微观电子哈密顿量出发，证明传导电子的Zeeman耦合会产生场线性的三自旋相互作用，是时间反演对称允许的最低阶修正，并给出各向同性与相对论性两类的具体形式、求和规则与实验效应。
AI.motivation: 传统原子自旋模型只用单个磁矩的Zeeman能引入磁场，忽略了传导电子Zeeman耦合可能诱导的更高阶多自旋相互作用，这些项在时间反演对称下是允许的最低阶修正，值得系统刻画。
AI.method: 用巨势的格林函数展开，从微观电子哈密顿量推导场线性三自旋项；区分为无自旋轨道耦合的各向同性项 (S_i·S_j)(S_k·B)（满足费米面三站点电子环的求和规则）与需自旋轨道耦合的相对论项 K_ijk·B·χ_ijk（χ_ijk为标量自旋手性）；并用Hubbard三聚体精确对角化验证两通道独立可加。对Rashba电子气中的磁性三聚体给出解析表达（一阶K_ijk在面内、C_3v对称时消失、二阶出现面外分量）。
AI.result: 确认各向同性与相对论两通道彼此独立且可叠加；无自旋轨道耦合时手性耦合在自旋通道被禁戒，而轨道通道恢复Mott绝缘体的轨道通量机制；Rashba情形下K_ijk一阶在面内、C_3v三聚体时一阶为零、二阶出现面外分量。
AI.conclusion: 这些相互作用可移动磁化台阶场并改变场诱导的非共面性；连续极限下，手性耦合使斯格明子与反斯格明子分裂，相对论项产生依赖磁场的Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用。

title: Microscopic Derivation of Stochastic Thin-Film Equation and Extensions to Two-Layer and Evaporating Films
summary: While classical thin-film hydrodynamics models widely govern macroscopic fluid layers, they fail to capture the molecular-level thermal fluctuations that dictate nanoscale interfacial dynamics. Standard stochastic extensions rely on the long-wave approximation of the continuum fluctuating Navier-Stokes equations; however, this top-down paradigm lacks a formal connection to microscopic particle trajectories and cannot readily accommodate complex, non-equilibrium boundary mechanisms. We resolve this limitation by deriving the stochastic thin-film equation directly from the exact underlying N-particle Hamiltonian dynamics. This is achieved via a systematic, bottom-up coarse-graining framework based on a generalized fluctuating dynamic density-functional theory. Crucially, this first principles formulation offers unparalleled flexibility, enabling the seamless integration of multi-layered interfaces and non-conserved dynamics such as evaporation. For these complex configurations, our framework rigorously yields entirely novel stochastic thin-film equations featuring emergent noise terms that encapsulate microscopic fluctuations missing from classical top-down models.

AI.tldr: 作者从N粒子哈密顿动力学出发，自底向上粗粒化推导随机薄膜方程，无需长波近似，并可自然纳入多层界面与蒸发等非守恒动力学。
AI.motivation: 经典薄膜流体力学模型无法描述纳米界面处决定动力学的分子级热涨落；现有随机扩展依赖连续Navier-Stokes方程的长波近似，属自上而下范式，缺乏与微观粒子轨迹的形式联系，也难以处理复杂非平衡边界机制。
AI.method: 基于广义涨落动力学密度泛函理论，建立系统的自底向上粗粒化框架，从精确的N粒子哈密顿动力学直接推导随机薄膜方程。
AI.result: 该第一性原理框架可无缝整合多层界面与非守恒动力学（如蒸发），并严格导出全新形式的随机薄膜方程，其中涌现的噪声项刻画了经典自上而下模型所缺失的微观涨落。
AI.conclusion: 工作弥合了微观粒子动力学与随机薄膜流体力学之间的鸿沟，为纳米尺度界面涨落与非平衡现象的建模提供了具有灵活性、可扩展的第一性原理途径。

title: Precursor Ratio-Controlled Chloride Vacancies in Lead-Free KCuCl3-x Memristors for Forming-Free Gradual Resistive Switching and Neuromorphic Learning
summary: Defect engineering of memristive materials offers a powerful strategy for regulating ionic transport and analog resistive switching required for neuromorphic computing. Here, we report a wet chemical synthesis route for chloride-vacancy (VCl) engineering in lead-free all-inorganic KCuCl3-x thin films and establish a direct correlation between defect concentration, electronic structure, transport dynamics, and neuromorphic performance. Controlled precursor-ratio variation systematically tunes the VCl concentration in KCuCl3-x thin films, driving preferential vacancy formation at the terminal chloride sites, band-gap narrowing, and enhanced electronic disorder. W/KCuCl3-x/FTO memristors exhibit stable bipolar VCM-type resistive switching, with increasing VCl concentration promoting forming-free operation. An optimal VCl concentration (~ 1.3*10^21 cm^-3) provides a balance between ionic mobility and defect controllability, resulting in highly linear potentiation/depression characteristics and superior pulse endurance (>104 cycles). When the experimentally measured conductance characteristics of the optimized memristor are implemented as synaptic weights in artificial neural network simulations, recognition accuracies of 98.96% and 91.82% are achieved on the MNIST and Fashion-MNIST datasets, respectively. These findings establish precursor ratio-controlled VCl engineering as an effective strategy for simultaneously optimizing ionic transport, analog switching, and neuromorphic learning in lead-free halide perovskite memristors, providing a general materials design principle for energy-efficient neuromorphic electronics.

AI.tldr: 通过湿化学法调控KCuCl3-x薄膜中的氯空位浓度，实现无铅钙钛矿忆阻器的模拟阻变与神经形态性能优化。
AI.motivation: 缺陷工程可调控忆阻材料的离子传输与模拟阻变，是无铅卤化物钙钛矿神经形态器件性能优化的关键，但缺陷浓度与电子结构、传输动力学、神经形态性能之间的关联尚需建立。
AI.method: 采用湿化学合成，通过前驱体比例变化系统调控KCuCl3-x薄膜的氯空位（VCl）浓度；表征缺陷位点、带隙与电子无序；构建W/KCuCl3-x/FTO忆阻器，测试阻变与突触特性，并将实测电导作为权重进行ANN仿真。
AI.result: VCl优先形成于端位氯位点，引起带隙变窄与电子无序增强；器件呈稳定双极VCM型阻变，VCl增加促进免forming操作；最优浓度约1.3×10^21 cm^-3时兼具离子迁移率与可控性，实现高线性增强/抑制与>10^4脉冲耐久性；MNIST与Fashion-MNIST识别率达98.96%和91.82%。
AI.conclusion: 前驱体比例控制的氯空位工程可同时优化离子传输、模拟阻变与神经形态学习，为无铅卤化物钙钛矿忆阻器及节能神经形态电子学提供通用材料设计原则。

title: Pulsed Laser Deposition of Ferroelectric SrTiO3 Shells Enables Polarization-Controlled Charge Separation in TiO2 Photoanode
summary: Ferroelectric polarization offers a powerful route to govern the interfacial charge separation in photoelectrodes; however, chemically converted ferroelectric shells lack sub-nanometer thickness control, coherent strain retention, and chemically clean interfaces. Here, we use pulsed laser deposition to fabricate stoichiometric SrTiO3 shells on hydrothermally grown TiO2 nanorod arrays, achieving atomically defined core-shell architectures while preserving the one-dimensional transport geometry. The photocurrent density followed a volcano-shaped dependence on shell thickness and reached 1.9 mA cm-2 at 1.23 V versus RHE under AM 1.5G illumination for the optimized 15-mins sample, exceeding the established hydrothermal benchmark. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy revealed a tetragonally distorted, oxygen-stoichiometric shell, identifying coherent interfacial strain rather than defect dipoles as the origin of the ferroelectric order. Kelvin probe force microscopy directly imaged a polarization-induced built-in electric field whose magnitude scaled with charge-transfer efficiency and photocurrent density. Together, these complementary structural, chemical, electrostatic, and device-level measurements established a quantitative strain-polarization-built-in field-charge separation relationship. This work transforms ferroelectric photoanode engineering from empirical optimization into an atomically controllable and predictive materials strategy for high-efficiency solar water-splitting devices. This approach is readily extendable to visible-light absorbers and complex ferroelectric heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 采用PLD在TiO2纳米棒上制备原子级精确SrTiO3铁电壳层，界面共格应变诱导极化与内建电场，使光电流达1.9 mA cm-2，并建立应变-极化-电荷分离的定量设计关系。
AI.motivation: 铁电极化可调控光电极界面电荷分离，但化学法构建的铁电壳层难以实现亚纳米厚度控制、共格应变保持与化学洁净界面，限制其定量化设计与性能提升。
AI.method: 用水热法生长TiO2纳米棒阵列，结合脉冲激光沉积（PLD）在其上制备化学计量比SrTiO3壳层，构建原子级精确的核壳结构；通过HRTEM、XPS表征结构与化学状态，KPFM直接成像极化诱导的内建电场，并系统改变壳层厚度（如15 min样品）关联光电流与电荷转移效率。
AI.result: 光电流密度随壳层厚度呈火山型依赖，优化15 min样品在AM 1.5G、1.23 V vs RHE下达到1.9 mA cm-2，超过水热法基准；壳层呈四方畸变、氧化学计量，铁电性源于共格界面应变而非缺陷偶极；KPFM显示的内建电场强度与电荷转移效率、光电流密度一致。
AI.conclusion: 建立了应变—极化—内建电场—电荷分离的定量关系，将铁电光阳极设计从经验优化转变为原子级可控、可预测的材料策略，并可拓展至可见光吸收体与复杂铁电异质结。

title: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization reveals HiPIMS deposition rates exceeding direct current sputtering
summary: Pulsed sputter processes are essential for a wide range of applications from hard coatings to microelectronics. High power impulse magnetron sputtering (HiPIMS) offers unique possibilities for process design due to its high ionized flux fraction. Because of the high peak-current densities involved, correspondingly high plasma densities generate many ions. This enables tuning of kinetic energies by applying accelerating bias potentials. However, some HiPIMS processes have low deposition rates due to the back-attraction these ions experience with the negatively charged sputter target. Recent work in HiPIMS has targeted this problem, exploring complex pulsing schemes such as bipolar, multi-pulse, or chopped HiPIMS. These pulsing schemes introduce another problem: process complexity. As such, the process space, even with coarse intervals quickly blows up to 1E5-1E20 possible process combinations. This calls for efficient and intelligent sampling, which can be enabled by machine-learning algorithms such as Bayesian optimization. In this work we use multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) to efficiently sample the process space of pulse-packets, targeting high ionization flux fractions and deposition rates. Over 2,000 distinct processes were sampled during this exploration. Surprisingly, we found that many HiPIMS processes, including single pulse, can achieve deposition rates higher than DC references. In fact, at a working pressure of 1.0 Pa and moderate ionization rates of 5-20% we found that ms-scale pulses were ideal. We hypothesize these processes maximize gas rarefaction, creating a low-collision channel between the target and the substrate. These results showcase previously unreported behavior of pulsed sputter processes and challenge a long-held trade-off between film quality and speed in thin-film manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文使用多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）高效采样脉冲包（pulse-packet）HiPIMS 工艺空间，探索兼顾高离化通量分数与高沉积速率的方案。在采样超 2000 个工艺后，发现许多 HiPIMS 工艺（包括单脉冲）沉积速率可高于 DC 参考，并在 1.0 Pa、5–20% 离化率下，毫秒级脉冲表现理想，推测其通过最大化气体稀薄化形成低碰撞传输通道，挑战了薄膜质量与速度之间的传统权衡。
AI.motivation: HiPIMS 离化通量分数高、可调离子动能，但离子被负偏压靶背吸导致沉积速率低；双极、多脉冲、斩波等复杂脉冲方案虽可缓解该问题，却使工艺空间急剧膨胀（约 1E5–1E20 种组合），传统粗粒度采样难以高效探索。
AI.method: 采用多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）对 pulse-packet 脉冲工艺空间进行智能采样，以高离化通量分数和高沉积速率为双目标；共采样超过 2000 个不同工艺，并结合工作气压与离化率条件分析沉积速率表现。
AI.result: 许多 HiPIMS 工艺（含单脉冲）可实现高于 DC 参考的沉积速率；在 1.0 Pa 工作气压、5–20% 中等离化率条件下，毫秒级脉冲为理想选择。推测这些工艺最大化气体稀薄化，在靶与基片间形成低碰撞通道。
AI.conclusion: 结果展示了脉冲溅射工艺此前未报道的行为，挑战了薄膜制造中长期存在的“质量—速度”权衡；MOBO 为复杂脉冲工艺空间的高效智能采样提供了可行路径。

title: High-efficiency solid-state electrochemical thermal switching through phonon engineering of 2D materials
summary: Reversible solid-state thermal switches with large thermal contrasts remain rare, yet are essential for advanced thermal management. Using universal machine-learned interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) and density functional theory (DFT), we screen 57 transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs), spanning the 1T and 2H phases with Li and Mg intercalation. Among the candidates, Li$_a$ZrS$_2$ combines exceptional thermal conductivity switching with low heat capacity. Lithiation to Li$_{0.125}$ZrS$_2$ reduces the cross-plane thermal conductivity from approximately 3.7 to 0.05 W m$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$. The switching behaviour exceeds that of previously reported solid-state electrochemical thermal switches. Device-level modelling further demonstrates the potential for waste-heat recovery, with a pulsed system capturing 86\% of the energy recovered by an ideal switch. We attribute the switching behaviour to substantial softening of the Zr--Zr framework, with the mean force constant decreasing from approximately 4.2 to 1.2 eV $\mathrm{\mathring{A}}^{-2}$, alongside enhanced scattering of heat-carrying acoustic phonons. These findings establish electrochemical intercalation as a promising route to engineering thermal transport in layered materials.

AI.tldr: 利用uMLIPs与DFT筛选57种TMDC体系，发现Li₀.₁₂₅ZrS₂可将面外热导率从约3.7降至0.05 W m⁻¹K⁻¹，性能优于已有固态电化学热开关，并具备废热回收潜力。
AI.motivation: 可逆、大热对比度的固态热开关对先进热管理至关重要，但现有材料稀缺，需寻找新的热输运调控途径。
AI.method: 结合普适机器学习原子间势（uMLIPs）与密度泛函理论（DFT），系统筛选57种过渡金属二硫属化物（覆盖1T与2H相、Li与Mg插层），并进行器件级建模与声子分析。
AI.result: LiₐZrS₂表现最佳：锂化至Li₀.₁₂₅ZrS₂时面外热导率由约3.7降至0.05 W m⁻¹K⁻¹，且热容低；脉冲系统可回收理想开关86%的能量。机理为Zr–Zr骨架显著软化（平均力常数约4.2→1.2 eV Å⁻²）及声学声子散射增强。
AI.conclusion: 电化学插层是调控层状材料热输运的有效途径，可用于高性能固态热开关与废热回收。

title: Retention-constrained fine-tuning of a pre-trained aluminium MACE potential for non-equilibrium defect dynamics and plasticity
summary: Adapting a pre-trained machine-learning interatomic potential for non-equilibrium defect dynamics and plasticity requires improving defect accuracy without degrading the near-equilibrium elastic and vibrational response. Here we achieve this balance for the aluminium MACE potential QP17 by integrating conditional readout uncertainty, iterative full-parameter updates and protocol-compatible relative-energy anchoring. Sensitivities over 144 linear readout weights guide acquisition, with within-batch covariance updates and evolving neural representations. After four active-learning rounds (32 acquired configurations and 400 gradient updates), force-uncertainty acquisition reduces mean development force error from 22.43 to 21.52 meV/Angstrom, outperforming random sampling (22.70), geometry-diversity selection (22.46) and uniform training across all 104 candidate labels (22.71) under the same update budget. All three force-uncertainty runs satisfy bulk-mechanical retention criteria: historical relative-energy error decreases from 0.375 to 0.207 meV/atom, while harmonic phonon root-mean-square drift remains below 0.05 THz. Matched objective ablations reveal that relative-energy anchoring suppresses harmonic drift. Out-of-sample evaluations across planar faults, twin boundaries and grain boundaries demonstrate transferable gains in defect energies and deviatoric stresses, even though virial stresses are never fitted. A closed-loop molecular dynamics and density functional theory (MD-DFT) pilot confirms that automated acceptance gating intercepts updates that violate historical elastic-group energy or vibrational tolerances. Together, these components establish a retention-constrained fine-tuning protocol for improving plastic-deformation observables while preserving the tested bulk mechanical response.

AI.tldr: 通过在铝MACE势QP17上引入条件读出不确定度、全参数迭代更新与协议兼容的相对能量锚定，实现缺陷动力学精度提升且不损害近平衡弹性与振动响应。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器学习原子间势要用于非平衡缺陷动力学和塑性模拟，需提升缺陷精度，同时不能降低近平衡弹性与振动响应，二者难以兼顾。
AI.method: 基于144个线性读出权重敏感性指导采样；采用批内协方差更新与演化神经表征的迭代全参数更新；加入协议兼容的相对能量锚定；进行4轮主动学习（32个构型、400次梯度更新），并与随机采样、几何多样性选择、全标签均匀训练对比；做匹配目标消融；进行MD-DFT闭环试验与自动验收门控。
AI.result: 力不确定度采样将开发集平均力误差从22.43降至21.52 meV/Å，优于随机(22.70)、几何多样性(22.46)与均匀训练(22.71)；历史相对能量误差由0.375降至0.207 meV/atom，谐振声子RMS漂移<0.05 THz；平面缺陷、孪晶界、晶界外推评估显示缺陷能与偏应力可迁移增益（未拟合维里应力）；MD-DFT试验验证门控可拦截违反弹性/振动容差的更新。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了保持约束下的微调协议，可在保持已测体相力学响应的同时改善塑性变形相关观测量。

title: Wrinkling dynamics of thin crystalline sheets and its dependency on topological defects
summary: We investigate the wrinkling dynamics of thin crystalline sheets under uniaxial compression using a Surface Phase-Field-Crystal-Helfrich (SPFCH) model, which captures the coupling between crystalline order, out-of-plane deformations, and topological defects. In particular, the model allows us to track and characterize two distinct classes of defects, namely those forming in the underlying hexagonal crystal lattice, such as dislocations and grain boundaries, and defects in the wrinkling patterns, known as wrinklons. By resolving the evolution and interactions of these defects, we investigate how the interplay between in-plane and out-of-plane relaxation mechanisms influences wrinkling onset and the coarsening regime. Our results indicate that crystalline defects do not affect coarsening scaling, but they quantitatively affect the onset of wrinkling and the emerging wrinkling wavelength, promote more irregular wrinkle patterns with a higher density of wrinklons, and modify long-timescale morphological evolution.

AI.tldr: 采用表面相场晶体-HELFrich (SPFCH) 模型研究薄膜在单轴压缩下的褶皱动力学，揭示晶格缺陷与褶皱缺陷(wrinklon)的相互作用。
AI.motivation: 薄膜褶皱中晶体有序、面外形变与拓扑缺陷的耦合机制尚不清楚，尤其晶格缺陷(位错、晶界)如何影响褶皱起始与粗化过程缺乏定量认识。
AI.method: 构建 SPFCH 模型，耦合六角晶体序、面外变形与缺陷，能够同时追踪晶格缺陷(位错、晶界)和褶皱缺陷(wrinklon)，解析其演化与相互作用，考察面内、面外弛豫机制对褶皱起始和粗化的影响。
AI.result: 晶格缺陷不改变粗化的标度律，但定量影响褶皱起始与波长，诱导更不规则、wrinklon 密度更高的褶皱图案，并改变长时间尺度的形貌演化。
AI.conclusion: 晶格缺陷虽不影响粗化普适标度，却显著调控褶皱起始、波长及长期形貌，说明面内晶体缺陷与面外褶皱缺陷的耦合是薄膜褶皱动力学的重要调控因素。

title: Information-theoretic entropy imaging of quantum matter
comment: 34 pages including Supplementary Information; 4 main text figures and 21 supplementary figures. Address correspondence to mtallen[at]ucsd.edu and tagrover[at]ucsd.edu
summary: Phase transitions can generate intricate spatial organization invisible to spatially averaged probes, yet quantitative measures of this organization remain limited. Here we develop "entropy imaging," an information-theoretic technique that harnesses lossless compression to quantify spatial complexity, predictability, and order in quantum materials. Using this approach, emergent spatial textures can be imaged and converted into an experimentally-accessible observable: the computable information density (CID), a compression-based measure of information complexity that approaches the Shannon entropy rate in the large-system limit. Applied to millikelvin microwave impedance microscopy of graphene, the method reveals a pronounced maximum in the CID near quantum Hall transitions, a quantitative measure of the information-rich spatial organization of the critical landscape. A disordered Hofstadter model reproduces this behavior and shows that the CID can identify the quantum critical point from a sequence of images, without ensemble averaging over disorder realizations. The same framework tracks fractional quantum Hall transitions and resolves isolated fractional puddles that coexist with a disordered background. By contrast, the trivial band-edge crossover in a MoSe2/WS2 moiré heterobilayer exhibits qualitatively different behavior, suggesting that the pronounced CID enhancement observed at the quantum Hall critical point is not simply a generic feature of a conductive-insulating crossover. We further show that the geometric information encoded in CID is not reducible to a correlation length, and it can even distinguish spatial textures with identical multifractal statistics. Together, these results establish lossless compression as a framework for quantifying emergent spatial organization in quantum materials, with portability across imaging modalities and physical systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"熵成像"(entropy imaging)技术，用无损压缩把量子材料中的空间纹理转成可测量的"可计算信息密度"(CID)，并在石墨烯量子霍尔转变与分数量子霍尔、莫尔异质结上验证其能定量刻画临界空间组织。
AI.motivation: 相变产生的复杂空间组织对空间平均探针不可见，而现有定量刻画手段有限；需要一种能刻画空间复杂度、可预测性与有序度的信息论方法。
AI.method: 基于无损压缩构造可计算信息密度CID（大系统极限下趋近Shannon熵率），对石墨烯毫开温区微波阻抗显微图像成像分析；用无序Hofstadter模型对比；并以MoSe2/WS2莫尔异质结的平庸带边crossing作对照。
AI.result: 量子霍尔转变附近CID出现显著极大值，可定量反映临界态信息丰富的空间组织；无序Hofstadter模型复现该行为并能不依赖无序平均、仅由图像序列定位量子临界点；亦能追踪分数量子霍尔转变并分辨孤立分数puddles；MoSe2/WS2平庸转变呈不同行为；CID所含几何信息不可约化为关联长度，甚至能区分具相同多重分形统计的纹理。
AI.conclusion: 无损压缩可成为量化量子材料中涌现空间组织的普适框架，可跨成像模式与物理系统移植。

title: Modeling the CNOT gate in Germanium double quantum dots
summary: We model a controlled-NOT (CNOT) gate mediated by exchange interactions in a realistic Ge/GeSi hole spin-qubit device. We use for that purpose a computationally efficient framework based on a compact dressed basis of many-body singlet and triplet states, which enables fast time-dependent simulations that would be prohibitive within a conventional configuration-interaction approach. We discuss the dominant sources of infidelity in ideal (noise-free) devices. On the one hand, the nonadiabaticity of the tunnel barrier ramps, enhanced by the transverse component of the exchange interaction, imposes limits on the speed of the CNOT gate. On the other hand, the AC Stark shift of the conditional resonance and the off-resonant driving of the complementary transition can significantly degrade the gate fidelity and call for a careful optimization of the driving conditions. Finally, we investigate the impact of quasi-static charge noise on the fidelity of the CNOT gate. We find that the capture of charges near the qubits can strongly disrupt the conditional operation, while the nanometer-scale motion of charges results in a loss of fidelity that sensitively depends on the position and strength of the corresponding dipole. Our results quantify the requirements on barrier control, microwave driving, and charge-noise stability for high-fidelity two-qubit operations in Ge/GeSi hole-spin qubits.

AI.tldr: 本文用基于多体单态-三重态"缀饰基"的高效框架，模拟Ge/GeSi空穴自旋量子比特器件中由交换相互作用介导的CNOT门，量化无噪声与非绝热、AC Stark、非共振驱动及准静态电荷噪声对保真度的影响。
AI.motivation: Ge/GeSi空穴自旋量子比特是两比特门的有力候选，但交换型CNOT门在真实器件中的主要误差来源（隧道势垒非绝热性、驱动相关效应、电荷噪声）尚缺乏定量认识，而传统组态相互作用方法难以支撑快速时变模拟。
AI.method: 构建由多体单态与三重态组成的紧凑"缀饰基"，替代常规组态相互作用，实现快速时间依赖模拟；在此框架下建模交换相互作用介导的CNOT门，并分别分析无噪声情形下的非绝热性（含交换作用横向分量）、条件共振的AC Stark位移与互补跃迁的非共振驱动，以及准静态电荷噪声（电荷俘获与纳米尺度电荷运动/偶极扰动）。
AI.result: 隧道势垒斜率的非绝热性（被交换作用横向分量放大）限制了CNOT门速；AC Stark位移与离共振驱动显著降低保真度，需仔细优化驱动条件；电荷被俘获在量子比特附近会严重破坏条件操作，而电荷纳米尺度运动造成的保真度损失强烈依赖于相应偶极的位置与强度。
AI.conclusion: 研究定量给出了Ge/GeSi空穴自旋量子比特实现高保真两比特操作时对势垒控制、微波驱动与电荷噪声稳定性的要求。

title: Phonon-assisted shift-current from first-principles: application to AlN monolayer
summary: In this work, we present a first-principles approach to investigate phonon-assisted shift current in extended systems. Our method combines the special displacement technique with real-time simulations based on the dynamical Berry phase. Merging these two frameworks enables direct access to non-linear optical responses at finite temperatures, while naturally incorporating phonon scattering and phonon-assisted electronic transitions into the time-dependent dynamics. This allows us to capture temperature-dependent features and lattice fluctuations that are essential for a realistic description of non-linear photocurrent generation. As a representative example, we apply our approach to the shift-current response of a monolayer of hexagonal AlN (h-AlN). This system provides an ideal testing ground because it features an indirect band gap and lacks inversion symmetry. Moreover, h-AlN layers of different thicknesses have been fabricated and characterized in a variety of experimental settings, opening the concrete possibility of testing our predictions. Our results demonstrate the relevance of phonon-mediated processes and the importance of temperature in determining the magnitude and spectral features of the shift current in layered materials.

AI.tldr: 作者提出结合特殊位移技术与基于动力学Berry相位的实时模拟的第一性原理方法，研究有限温度下扩展体系中的声子辅助shift current（移位电流），并以单层六方AlN为示例，揭示了声子介导过程与温度对非线性光电流幅度及谱特征的重要影响。
AI.motivation: 真实材料中非线性光电流（shift current）受温度与晶格涨落影响，但已有理论多局限于零温、忽略声子散射与声子辅助电子跃迁，难以真实描述有限温度下的非线性光伏响应。
AI.method: 将"特殊位移技术"（sampling晶格热涨落）与基于"动力学Berry相位"的实时（real-time）含时模拟相结合，构建第一性原理框架；在含时动力学中自然纳入声子散射和声子辅助电子跃迁，从而直接获得有限温度下的非线性光学响应；应用于单层六方AlN（间接带隙、无反演对称性）。
AI.result: 在单层h-AlN上演示了有限温度shift current的计算，结果表明声子介导过程显著，温度会改变shift current的幅度与光谱特征；同时h-AlN不同厚度层已被实验制备与表征，使预测具备可验证性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了在有限温度下直接计算声子辅助非线性光电流的第一性原理途径，强调温度与晶格涨落在层状材料shift current描述中的必要性，并给出可在实验上检验的预测。

title: Information-thermodynamic principles unveil the response of complex networks to perturbations
summary: Understanding how complex networks respond to perturbations is key to uncovering their functional organization. We show that, for a maximum-entropy perturbation prior, standard diffusion cannot increase response entropy, a measure of the diversity of the system's response. To overcome this limitation, we develop a density-matrix-based information thermodynamics of perturbation responses along arbitrary dynamical trajectories. We show that this framework is grounded in an information-theoretic principle of least dissipation and introduces a generalized free energy that quantifies deviations from an instantaneous diffusive reference. We then illustrate the formalism using nonlinear complex networks, revealing regimes of enhanced response diversity that cannot be captured by standard diffusive descriptions.

AI.tldr: 本文基于密度矩阵构建了扰动响应的信息热力学框架，指出标准扩散在最大熵扰动先验下无法增加响应熵，并提出以最小耗散原理和广义自由能刻画偏离扩散参考的响应多样性增强。
AI.motivation: 复杂网络对扰动的响应是其功能组织的关键，但标准扩散模型在最大熵扰动先验下无法增加响应熵（响应多样性），限制了对系统响应行为的描述能力。
AI.method: 证明最大熵扰动先验下标准扩散不能提升响应熵；随后发展基于密度矩阵的、沿任意动力学轨迹的扰动响应信息热力学，建立在最小耗散的信息论原理之上，并引入量化偏离瞬时扩散参考的广义自由能；用非线性复杂网络进行说明。
AI.result: 标准扩散在最大熵先验下无法增加响应熵；新框架能刻画标准扩散描述无法捕捉的响应多样性增强区间，并在非线性复杂网络中展示该现象。
AI.conclusion: 密度矩阵信息热力学为扰动响应提供了更普适的描述，揭示了超出标准扩散范畴的响应多样性增强机制。

title: Third harmonic generation in the transition metal trichalcogenides
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures (main text and Supplemental Material combined). Published in Physical Review Materials
summary: The transition metal trichalcogenides (TMTs) are an interesting class of layered 2D materials that have strong anisotropic electrical and optical properties. We report on the polarization-dependent nonlinear optical response of exfoliated crystals at the third harmonic using non-resonant excitation with a 1560 nm femtosecond laser. All members of the TMT crystal family explored (ZrS3, HfS3, TiS3, and NbS3) display large anisotropy in their polarized third harmonic generation signal, with anisotropy ratios as large as chi_11/chi_22 ~ 6.5. From the expected nonlinear dependence of these monoclinic and triclinic crystals we extract the relative nonlinear susceptibility coefficients. We find that the anisotropy ratio is largest for ZrS3 and decreases across the family, a trend we associate with the proximity of the third harmonic energy to the strongly b-polarized absorption edge of each material. NbS3, the only triclinic crystal, displays a pronounced anisotropy in thick flakes that is strongly reduced in the thinnest flakes, which we attribute to a partial relaxation of the Peierls-type Nb-Nb dimerization that underlies the triclinic distortion. The large anisotropic nonlinear response in this crystal family sets it apart from other 2D materials and makes it particularly attractive for further investigation.

AI.tldr: 该文报道了ZrS3、HfS3、TiS3、NbS3四种过渡金属三硫属化合物剥离晶体的偏振依赖三次谐波响应，各材料均表现出强各向异性（最大χ11/χ22~6.5），并提取了相对非线性极化率系数。
AI.motivation: 过渡金属三硫属化合物（TMTs）是具有强各向异性电学和光学性质的二维层状材料，但其非线性光学响应的各向异性鲜有系统研究，作者希望量化该家族的三次谐波各向异性并理解其来源。
AI.method: 用1560 nm飞秒激光作非共振激发，测量剥离TMT晶体的偏振依赖三次谐波产生信号；基于单斜和三斜晶系的预期非线性张量，提取相对非线性极化率系数；并比较不同厚度（尤其NbS3厚薄片）的响应。
AI.result: 所有四种材料都显示强偏振各向异性，χ11/χ22最大约6.5；各向异性比在ZrS3中最大并向该家族其他成员递减，作者将其归因于三次谐波能量接近各材料强b偏振吸收边；三斜NbS3在厚片中表现出显著各向异性，但在最薄片中明显减弱，被归因于Peierls型Nb-Nb二聚化的部分弛豫。
AI.conclusion: TMT晶体家族具有大且可调控的各向异性非线性光学响应，使其区别于其他二维材料，值得进一步研究。

title: Autonomous atomistic-continuum coupling through uncertainty-aware active learning
comment: Accepted to Multiscale and Multidisciplinary Modeling, Experiments and Design
summary: We develop an uncertainty-aware surrogate modeling approach for coupling an atomistic kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) surface-chemistry solver with a continuum multi-species fluid dynamics solver across disparate physical length and time scales. The surrogate model predicts boundary mass fluxes for six species and their uncertainties, which the continuum solver monitors to automatically trigger additional KMC simulations when new training data are needed. This enables efficient multiscale coupling and maintains a user-specified level of accuracy. We demonstrate the approach for reactive halide-perovskite vapor deposition, which involves a multi-species vapor jet impinging on a reactive substrate. The KMC solver uses a DFT-calibrated energetics model that we construct as part of this work and provides net deposition and desorption rates for six species. With a conservative uncertainty threshold, the surrogate-coupled approach reproduces cumulative mass fluxes of the directly coupled approach with errors typically within 10-20%, while capturing the non-monotonic dependence of net deposition on species partial pressure. Importantly, the results show that detailed crystal structure need not be explicitly represented to predict quantities exchanged between atomistic and continuum solvers; species-resolved mass fluxes provide a sufficiently low-dimensional representation of the atomistic response. For this accuracy target, the autonomous online-learning approach reduces the number of required atomistic simulations by two to three orders of magnitude relative to direct multiscale coupling.

AI.tldr: 提出不确定性感知代理模型，耦合KMC表面化学与连续介质流体求解器，用物种分辨质量通量低维表示原子尺度响应，在线学习减少2–3个数量级KMC模拟。
AI.motivation: 原子尺度KMC与连续介质流体求解器之间存在巨大的空间与时间尺度差异，直接耦合需要海量原子模拟，计算代价过高；同时需保证多尺度耦合精度可控。
AI.method: 构建预测六种物种边界质量通量及其不确定性的代理模型；连续求解器监测不确定性，超阈值时自动触发新KMC模拟进行在线学习；KMC采用本文构建的DFT标定能量学模型；以卤化物钙钛矿气相沉积（多物种蒸汽射流撞击反应衬底）为示范案例。
AI.result: 在保守不确定性阈值下，代理耦合方法重现直接耦合的累积质量通量，误差通常在10–20%以内，并捕捉到净沉积对物种分压的非单调依赖；表明无需显式表示晶体结构，物种分辨质量通量即为足够低维的原子响应表示；原子模拟次数减少2–3个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性驱动的在线学习代理耦合可在保持用户指定精度的同时大幅降低多尺度模拟成本，并为原子-连续耦合提供低维、无需详细晶体结构的通量级表示。

title: Methyl radicals dynamics on (100)--(2x1):H diamond surfaces based on refined variational transition state calculations of gas-surface reaction rate coefficients
summary: Theoretical modelling of diamond growth should ideally provide estimates of the growth rate depending on experimental conditions. To that end, a description of all possible reactions related to the competing adsorption, desorption and migration mechanisms is required. Here, we provide precise calculations of the reaction rate coefficient of methyl-related reactions on hydrogen-terminated (100) diamond surface, as $\mathrm{CH_3}$ is known to be the main growth precursor in chemical vapor deposition (CVD) growth of diamond. To achieve this goal, we successfully combined Density Functional Theory (DFT) and variational transition state theory (VTST), allowing to extend our analysis to barrierless reaction. Our rigorous treatment of the quasi-free rotation of $\mathrm{CH_3}$ adsorbates on the surface allows us to overcome numerical errors for the finite difference calculations of the vibrational spectra for evaluating the partition functions of the system. Our results suggest that the mechanism that deplete the $\mathrm{CH_3}$ concentration the most is the absorption on a surface radical site. We also evidence the anisotropy of $\mathrm{CH_3}$ migration along the dimer of the (100)-(2x1):H surface. In a more general perspective, the calculated reaction rates coefficient for methyl reactions and migration presented in this work, together with the data for hydrogen reaction and other main gas surface reactions, bridge the gap between the atomic-scale description and the large-scale modelling of diamond growth.

AI.tldr: 本文结合DFT与变分过渡态理论(VTST)精确计算了氢终止(100)金刚石表面甲基相关反应及迁移的速率系数，揭示了CH₃吸附消耗机制与迁移各向异性。
AI.motivation: 金刚石生长的理论建模需要根据实验条件估算生长速率，这要求描述竞争性吸附、脱附和迁移等所有相关反应；而CH₃是CVD金刚石生长的主要前驱体，其表面反应速率系数的精确计算尚属空白。
AI.method: 将密度泛函理论(DFT)与变分过渡态理论(VTST)结合，使分析可延伸至无势垒反应；对CH₃吸附物准自由转动进行严格处理，克服有限差分法计算振动谱以评估配分函数时的数值误差。
AI.result: 结果表明，消耗CH₃浓度最强的机制是其在表面自由基位点上的吸附；同时发现CH₃沿(100)-(2x1):H表面二聚体迁移存在各向异性。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出的甲基反应与迁移速率系数，结合氢反应及其他主要气-表面反应数据，弥合了原子尺度描述与金刚石生长大尺度建模之间的鸿沟。

title: Growth Phase Map of α and \b{eta} Tantalum as a Function of Growth Temperature and Oxygen Partial Pressure
summary: Tantalum thin films are used in low-loss superconducting quantum circuits, yet the growth conditions governing selection of $α$-Ta(110), $α$-Ta(111), and metastable $β$-Ta on c-plane sapphire remain uncertain. We deposited 100 nm Ta films by dc magnetron sputtering on Al$_2$O$_3$(0001) at 300-900 $^\circ$C while varying the O$_2$ partial pressure from a $5.5\times10^{-11}$ Torr ultrahigh-vacuum baseline to $2.23\times10^{-4}$ Torr. Absorption-corrected X-ray diffraction texture coefficients were used to construct a ternary phase-orientation growth map in terms of temperature and the oxygen-to-Ta impingement flux ratio ($2Φ_{O_2}/Φ_{Ta}\leq4.8\times10^{-6}$ to 19). Without added oxygen, $α$-Ta(110) dominated at every temperature. At an O$_2$ pressure of only $2.5\times10^{-9}$ Torr ($2Φ_{O_2}/Φ_{Ta}=2.2\times10^{-4}$), $α$-Ta(111) accounted for 98-99% of the normalized texture weight from 300 to 700 $^\circ$C, decreasing to 65% at 900 $^\circ$C. Substantial $β$-Ta formed only at the highest oxygen dose, dominating at 300 $^\circ$C and disappearing at 900 $^\circ$C. The apparent $β$(001)/$α$(110) selection energy of $1.07\pm0.16$ eV is comparable to the activation energy for oxygen diffusion in Ta, consistent with oxygen transport influencing phase selection. Oxygen also produced orientation-dependent changes in crystallite size and microstrain. These findings establish oxygen-controlled processing windows for phase- and orientation-selective growth of Ta films for superconducting devices.

AI.tldr: 通过调控溅射时的氧气分压与温度，构建了Ta薄膜的相-取向三元生长图谱，明确α-Ta(110)、α-Ta(111)、β-Ta的选择窗口。
AI.motivation: 钽薄膜用于低损耗超导量子电路，但在c面蓝宝石上生长α-Ta(110)、α-Ta(111)和亚稳β-Ta的条件尚不明确，缺乏可控的相与取向选择依据。
AI.method: 在Al₂O₃(0001)上用直流磁控溅射沉积100 nm Ta膜，温度300–900 °C，O₂分压从5.5×10⁻¹¹ Torr基線调至2.23×10⁻⁴ Torr；用吸收校正的XRD织构系数构建温度与氧/钽碰撞通量比的三元相-取向生长图。
AI.result: 无额外氧时各温度均为α-Ta(110)主导；O₂仅2.5×10⁻⁹ Torr时α-Ta(111)在300–700 °C占98–99%，900 °C降至65%；β-Ta只在最高氧剂量下显著形成（300 °C主导，900 °C消失）。β(001)/α(110)表观选择能1.07±0.16 eV，与氧在Ta中的扩散激活能相当。氧还引起晶粒尺寸与微应变的取向依赖变化。
AI.conclusion: 建立了氧控的工艺窗口，可实现Ta薄膜相与取向的选择性生长，为超导器件制备提供指导。

title: Local Broadband Gigahertz Spectroscopy via SQUID-on-Tip DC Readout
summary: Superconducting microwave circuits are shaped by their local electromagnetic environment, yet standard microwave measurements do not resolve the local fields and device features that govern their behavior. Here, we combine microwave spectroscopy, nanoscale magnetic sensing, and topographic imaging in a single tapping-mode SQUID-on-tip microscope. The nonlinear Josephson response converts local GHz excitations into Shapiro steps, enabling quantitative measurements of microwave frequency signals and their excitation strength using only DC readout. Applied to a superconducting coplanar waveguide resonator, local spectroscopy reproduces the power-dependent resonance and nonlinear bifurcation observed in microwave transmission measurements. Spatially resolved measurements map the microwave response while simultaneously recording topography and static magnetic features, including vortices and Meissner screening currents. Electromagnetic simulations reveal how coupling through the superconducting probe leads limits spatial resolution and guides localized detector designs. Together, these capabilities establish a platform for correlating microwave circuit dynamics with the local structural and magnetic environment of superconducting devices.

AI.tldr: 本文在单一轻敲模式 SQUID-on-tip 显微镜中集成微波光谱、纳米磁传感与形貌成像，利用约瑟夫森非线性响应把局域 GHz 激发转换为 Shapiro 台阶，从而仅用直流读出即可定量测量微波频率与激发强度，并实现对超导共面波导谐振器局域微波响应、涡旋与迈斯纳电流的空间分辨成像。
AI.motivation: 超导微波电路的行为由其局域电磁环境决定，但标准微波输运测量无法分辨决定器件行为的局域场与器件微结构特征，缺乏将微波电路动力学与局域结构、磁环境关联起来的表征手段。
AI.method: 将微波光谱、纳米尺度磁传感和形貌成像集成在一台轻敲模式 SQUID-on-tip 显微镜中；利用约瑟夫森结的非线性响应把局域 GHz 激发转换为 Shapiro 台阶，用纯直流读出定量获取微波频率与激发强度；对超导共面波导谐振器进行局域光谱与空间分辨测量，同时记录形貌与静态磁特征（涡旋、迈斯纳屏蔽电流），并结合电磁仿真分析探针耦合对空间分辨率的限制。
AI.result: 局域光谱复现了微波透射测量中观察到的功率相关共振与非线性分叉行为；空间分辨测量同时给出了微波响应分布、形貌以及涡旋和迈斯纳屏蔽电流等静态磁特征；电磁仿真揭示了通过超导探针的耦合如何限制空间分辨率，并为局域探测器设计提供指导。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个可将微波电路动力学与超导器件局域结构和磁环境相关联的测量平台，为超导微波器件的局域表征与探测器优化提供了新途径。

title: The fate of $s_{\pm}$ superconductivity in the bilayer nickelate La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$
summary: Motivated by the recent measurement of high-temperature superconductivity in the bilayer nickelate system La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ in the bulk as well as thin film samples, we seek to understand the role of the interlayer coupling in this system in dictating the pairing symmetry. Many proposals posit the existence of an $s_\pm$ superconducting phase in close competition with the mroe conventional cuprate-like $d$-wave state in both weak- and strong-coupling theories. However, at least in the latter, the effects of Coulomb repulsion and the double occupancy constraint have been largely neglected. In this manuscript, we propose a mean-field fractionalization treatment that captures the full $SU(2)$ particle-hole symmetry of the t-J model at half-filling, and show how a systematic treatment of this new symmetry leads to an added Coulomb pseudopotential constraint - one that is absent in the usual $U(1)$ treatment. We then apply this new fractionalization scheme to a simplified bilayer t-J model of La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$, showing how the Coulomb pseudopotential suppresses the existence of $s_\pm$ symmetry in favor of $d$-wave pairing.

AI.tldr: 本文用保留t-J模型满占据时完整SU(2)粒子-空穴对称性的平均场分数化方法处理La₃Ni₂O₇双层模型，发现该对称性引入额外的库仑赝势约束，从而抑制s±配对、支持d波配对。
AI.motivation: La₃Ni₂O₇中高温超导的发现引发对其配对对称性的争论：许多方案认为s±相与类铜氧化物的d波相接近且竞争激烈，但在强耦合理论中库仑排斥与双占据约束长期被忽视。作者希望厘清层间耦合如何决定配对对称性。
AI.method: 提出一种平均场分数化处理，保留t-J模型在半满时的完整SU(2)粒子-空穴对称性；将这一新对称性的系统处理与通常的U(1)处理对比，导出额外的库仑赝势约束；随后将其应用于简化的La₃Ni₂O₇双层t-J模型。
AI.result: SU(2)对称性的系统处理带来U(1)处理中不存在的库仑赝势约束；在双层t-J模型中，该赝势抑制s±对称性，使d波配对占优。
AI.conclusion: 正确计入SU(2)粒子-空穴对称性及其库仑赝势约束后，La₃Ni₂O₇的配对对称性更倾向于d波而非s±，强调强耦合理论中双占据约束不可忽略。

title: Collinear and Coplanar Altermagnetism in a Penrose Quasicrystal
summary: We generalize the previous group-theory based classification of collinear magnetism in the quasicrystal (QC) to general magnetic states. Taking the Penrose lattice as an example, we find that all magnetic states belonging to 2D irreducible representations (IRRPs) of the $D_5$ point group, including collinear states and coplanar ones, correspond to altermagnetism (AM). Unlike conventional collinear AM wherein zero magnetism is protected by, e.g. rotation or mirror reflection, which globally flip the spin in the magnetic pattern, the zero magnetism in these 2D-IRRP states is instead protected by a special group-theory-orthogonality theorem that basis functions belonging to different IRRPs are always mutually orthogonal. Taking the single-orbital Penrose-Hubbard as an example, our linear-response theory based calculations show that the largest portion of the parameter space is occupied by these 2D-IRRP states, and our further Ginzburg-Landau theory based analysis reveals that the polarization directions of the two basis magnetic states in the 2D IRRPs can be either parallel or perpendicular, leading to collinear or coplanar magnetic states. The special group-theory-orthogonality compensation mechanism and the absence of the PT symmetry finally leads to AM states, which are to be verified by the spin split in the spin-dependent angle-resolved-photoemission-spectrum and the spin conductance. These intriguing collinear and coplanar AM can also emerge in other QCs.

AI.tldr: 本文把基于群论共线磁性分类推广到准晶的一般磁性态，以Penrose晶格为例，发现所有属于D5点群二维不可约表示（2D-IRRP）的磁性态（共线或共面）都对应交变磁性（altermagnetism, AM），其零净磁性由群论正交性定理而非传统自旋翻转操作保护。
AI.motivation: 此前准晶（QC）中磁性分类仅针对共线情形，且传统交变磁性中零磁性依赖旋转或镜面反射等全局翻转自旋的对称操作；准晶的二十面体/五重对称性缺少这类操作，需要更一般的分类框架来理解非共线及更广泛磁性态的性质。
AI.method: 将群论分类从共线磁性推广至一般磁性态；以Penrose晶格为例，按其D5点群不可约表示对磁性态分类。用基于线性响应理论的计算（单轨道Penrose-Hubbard模型）确定参数空间中各类态所占比例；再用Ginzburg-Landau理论分析二维不可约表示中两个基磁态的极化方向（平行或垂直），并考察对称性对AM的约束。
AI.result: 所有属于D5点群2D-IRRP的磁性态（含共线及共面）均为AM；其零磁性由不同不可约表示基函数相互正交的群论正交性定理保护，而非旋转/镜面等全局自旋翻转对称性。线性响应计算表明，单轨道Penrose-Hubbard模型参数空间中最大比例被2D-IRRP态占据。Ginzburg-Landau分析表明，2D-IRRP中两个基磁态极化方向可平行或垂直，分别对应共线或共面磁态。群论正交补偿机制与PT对称性的缺失共同导致AM态出现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个可推广至其他准晶的对称性框架，解释了共线与共面AM在准晶中的普遍存在；并指出这些AM态可通过自旋分辨角分辨光电子能谱中的自旋劈裂以及自旋电导来验证。

title: A neural accelerated roughness-resolved Discrete Element Method (Rough-DEM) for modeling granular systems
summary: The Discrete Element Method (DEM) is an indispensable tool for modeling and understanding the basic mechanical behaviors of (dry) granular media, a class of disordered material systems of significant interest to multiple scientific domains from (geo-)physics to (chemical) engineering. At the core of all present DEM frameworks is a phenomenological friction law--commonly chosen to be of the Amontons-Coulomb type--that models the frictional interaction among constituent grains. Here, inspired by research in the tribology community, we present an alternative, fundamentally different framework, termed roughness-resolved DEM (Rough-DEM), in which contact friction is handled in a more physics-based manner. In this framework, instead of using a friction law, we explicitly resolve the surface topography of each grain and let friction emerge from collective frictionless interactions of surface asperities. In essence, we trade phenomenology for physics at the cost of an increased computational demand. To mitigate the cost, we introduce an FE$^2$-like algorithm and a feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM)-based neural network surrogate, both of which are parallelized on GPU to accelerate contact computation. Crucially, using this framework in 2D, we (1) demonstrate the possibility of recovering a two-body-based Amontons-Coulomb-type friction behavior using a \textit{simple} representation of surface topography, and (2) identify many-body-based frictional behaviors--more specifically, the angle of repose values--that \textit{cannot always} be captured by current DEM frameworks under the same level of model complexity. We conclude by discussing future directions for Rough-DEM, as well as exciting new opportunities it could unlock for a wide range of emerging applications, including (designing) suspension rheology and metamaterial mechanics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"粗糙度分辨离散元法"(Rough-DEM)，显式解析颗粒表面形貌，让摩擦从无摩擦微凸体的集体相互作用中涌现，替代传统Amontons-Coulomb唯象摩擦律；并通过FE²式算法与FiLM神经网络代理(GPU并行)降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有DEM框架都以唯象摩擦律(通常为Amontons-Coulomb型)刻画颗粒间摩擦，缺乏物理基础，难以准确描述从二体到多体的复杂摩擦行为。
AI.method: 受摩擦学启发，显式分辨每个颗粒的表面形貌，将接触摩擦由表面微凸体的无摩擦集体相互作用涌现；为降低计算量，引入类FE²算法与基于FiLM的神经网络代理，并在GPU上并行化接触计算。
AI.result: 在二维情形下：(1)用简单的表面形貌表征即可复现基于二体的Amontons-Coulomb型摩擦行为；(2)识别出基于多体的摩擦行为(如休止角)，这些行为在同等模型复杂度下现有DEM框架并不总能捕捉。
AI.conclusion: Rough-DEM以物理替代唯象、以增加计算量为代价，可在同等复杂度下获得更丰富的摩擦行为；未来可应用于悬浮流变学(设计)与超材料力学等新兴领域。

title: Cavity Loss in QED Coupled-Cluster Theory: Polariton Linewidths, Driven Steady States, and the Rabi Splitting
summary: Molecular polariton experiments are performed in lossy cavities, whereas correlated ab initio polariton theory has been developed almost entirely for lossless cavities. In this work, cavity loss is added to real-time QED coupled-cluster theory (QED-CCSD-22) through a complex cavity frequency, which gives the non-Hermitian no-jump part of the Lindblad master equation. The resulting polariton linewidths and driven-dissipative steady states are, to our knowledge, the first from QED coupled-cluster theory. The linewidths obtained from the complex Jacobian and from real-time propagation agree and are partitioned by the biorthogonal photon numbers of the two polaritons. A closed-form continuous-wave drive of the cavity gives driven steady states and their lineshapes.

AI.tldr: 通过复腔频率将腔损耗引入实时QED耦合簇理论(QED-CCSD-22)，首次由QED耦合簇理论给出极化激元线宽与驱动耗散稳态。
AI.motivation: 实验在损耗腔中进行，但相关从头算极化激元理论几乎都针对无损耗腔，理论与实验存在缺口。
AI.method: 用复数腔频率在实时QED-CCSD-22中引入腔损耗，得到Lindblad主方程的非厄米no-jump部分；由复Jacobian与实时传播求线宽，并以双正交光子数分配线宽；用闭合形式连续波驱动求驱动稳态。
AI.result: 两种方法所得线宽一致，并按两个极化激元的双正交光子数划分；连续波驱动给出驱动稳态及其线型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将腔损耗与驱动纳入QED耦合簇框架，可计算极化激元线宽与稳态线型，弥合理论与损耗腔实验的差距。

title: Relativistic Cavity Quantum Electrodynamical Algebraic Diagrammatic Construction Method for Strong Light-Matter Coupling
summary: We present the relativistic four-component implementation of cavity quantum electrodynamical algebraic diagrammatic construction theory at second order (4c-QED-EE-ADC(2)) for the ab initio treatment of light-matter interactions. Starting from the unitary-transformed, origin-invariant Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian, a rigorous four-component Dirac-Hartree-Fock formulation including cavity effects is considered, forming the basis of the 4c-QED-EE-ADC(2) framework. Two variants are implemented, allowing cavity effects to be introduced either at the relativistic mean-field or exclusively at the electron-correlation level. Applications to Hg, AuH, and halogen hydrides demonstrate that cavity coupling significantly modifies relativistic excitation spectra, induces strong state mixing, and enables tunable polaritonic features. Potential energy surface calculations for HBr further reveal cavity-induced qualitative changes in excited-state surfaces. It is also observed that the inclusion of photonic degrees of freedom leads to a moderate computational overhead of approximately three to five times relative to standard 4c-EE-ADC(2).

AI.tldr: 作者实现了四分量相对论腔量子电动力学二阶代数图解构造理论（4c-QED-EE-ADC(2)），用于从头算处理光-物质相互作用，并给出两种实施变体。
AI.motivation: 现有电子结构方法多非相对论，难以同时描述重元素的相对论效应与光腔中的强光-物质耦合，需发展兼顾二者的从头算框架。
AI.method: 从幺正变换、原点不变的Pauli-Fierz哈密顿量出发，构建含腔效应的严格四分量Dirac-Hartree-Fock，作为4c-QED-EE-ADC(2)基础；实现两变体：腔效应在相对论平均场层面引入，或仅在电子关联层面引入。
AI.result: 对Hg、AuH及卤化氢的应用表明：腔耦合显著改变相对论激发谱、引起强烈态混合并产生可调极化激元特征；HBr势能面计算显示腔诱导激发态势能面的定性变化；引入光子自由度仅带来约3–5倍相对标准4c-EE-ADC(2)的适度计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了可同时处理相对论效应与腔光-物质耦合的从头算方法，计算代价可控，为研究极化激元化学与重元素光谱提供工具。

title: Second order N-Electron Valence state Perturbation Theory for polaritonic systems
summary: Molecules strongly coupled to optical cavities often show multi-configurational character, which the cavity can enhance by mixing electronic states. Describing them accurately requires a complete treatment of correlation between all the involved quantum particles. The available QED ab-initio methods do not treat it in its completeness except for QED-FCI. We extend second-order N-electron valence state perturbation theory (NEVPT2) to polaritonic chemistry, in its state-specific (QED-NEVPT2) and quasi degenerate (QED-QD-NEVPT2) forms. Here, the correlation due to the interaction of more degenerate configurations comes from a QED-CASSCF reference, while that associated with instantaneous interactions between the particles is added by second-order perturbation theory. Application of the methods to ammonia, ethylene and formaldimine revealed that this approach represents the perfect alternative to the well established QED-Coupled Cluster approach when the molecular system is described by more degenerate configurations. The approaches developed in this work have the potential to become state-of-the-art methodologies for the description of reactivity and photochemistry in polaritonic systems.

AI.tldr: 将NEVPT2微扰理论扩展到极化激元化学，提出QED-NEVPT2与QED-QD-NEVPT2方法，在QED-CASSCF参考态基础上以二阶微扰引入瞬时相互作用关联，可作为QED-CC在多组态体系中的替代方案。
AI.motivation: 分子与光腔强耦合时呈现多组态特征，光腔还能通过混合电子态进一步增强该特征，需完整处理所有量子粒子间的关联。现有QED从头算方法中除QED-FCI外均无法完整处理，缺乏对多组态体系既准确又可行的关联方法。
AI.method: 将二阶N电子价态微扰理论（NEVPT2）推广到极化激元化学，构建态特定形式QED-NEVPT2与准简并形式QED-QD-NEVPT2。其中更多简并组态间相互作用带来的关联由QED-CASSCF参考态描述，粒子间瞬时相互作用相关关联则通过二阶微扰理论加入。
AI.result: 在氨、乙烯和甲亚胺三个体系上应用，结果表明当分子体系由较多简并组态描述时，该方法是成熟QED-耦合簇（QED-CC）方法的理想替代。
AI.conclusion: 所发展的方法有望成为描述极化激元体系反应性与光化学的先进（state-of-the-art）方法学。

title: Preparing State-Selected Molecular Beams with high Efficiency using Quantum Cascade Lasers
comment: Main manuscript: 7 pages, Supplementary Information: 9 pages
summary: We demonstrate the ro-vibrational state-selective preparation of CO molecules ($v$ = 0, J = 0 $\rightarrow$ $v$ = 1, J = 1) in an internally cold molecular beam using a continuous-wave, narrow-linewidth distributed feedback type quantum cascade laser, with an output wavelength of 4.65 $μ$m. Using a modulation-free wavelength stabilization scheme, we show that population transfer to near saturation levels can be obtained with sufficient long term stability, as needed for state-resolved scattering experiments. We show preliminary results of CO molecules prepared in the $v$ = 1 state, scattering from a clean Cu(100) surface. This study showcases the promise of QCL based excitation for state-selected molecular beam based scattering experiments, especially involving transitions in the mid-infrared domain ($λ$ > 4.5 $μ$m) which are otherwise difficult to access using conventional sources.

AI.tldr: 使用4.65 μm连续波窄线宽分布反馈量子级联激光器，在内部冷却的CO分子束中实现振转态选择性制备（v=0,J=0→v=1,J=1），并展示其用于态分辨表面散射实验的可行性。
AI.motivation: 态分辨分子束散射实验需要长期稳定的高布居转移，而λ>4.5 μm中红外跃迁用传统光源难以实现，故探索QCL作为激发光源。
AI.method: 采用DFB型QCL（4.65 μm）结合无调制波长锁定方案，对冷分子束中CO进行激发，验证饱和级布居转移与长期稳定性，并开展CO(v=1)与清洁Cu(100)表面的初步散射实验。
AI.result: 可实现接近饱和水平的布居转移，且具有满足态分辨散射实验所需的长期稳定性；获得v=1态CO在Cu(100)表面散射的初步结果。
AI.conclusion: QCL激发为态选择分子束散射实验提供了有前景的方案，尤其适用于传统光源难以覆盖的λ>4.5 μm中红外跃迁。

title: State-specific perturbation theory for configuration interaction singles: Theoretical analysis, benchmarks, and improvement with size-intensive level shifts
summary: We recently proposed a state-specific second-order perturbation theory based on the configuration interaction singles (CIS) state, termed CIS(2). Here, we clarify its theoretical connections, assess the accuracy of its excitation energies in greater detail, and develop size-intensive level shifts to improve both accuracy and convergence of its amplitude equations. We first derive the MP2 structure of its working equations and show that our previously introduced Hybrid partition recovers CIS(D) when the ground-state Fock operator is used and the residual Fock action on the CIS reference is neglected. For this partition, an expanded benchmark shows that using the CIS-state Fock operator improves Rydberg and especially charge-transfer accuracy relative to CIS(D), while slightly worsening valence accuracy. We analyze how the hole and particle densities contribute to these changes in excitation energy, which differ among the classes. We then introduce size-intensive level shifts that preserve the ground-state correlation contribution of noninteracting fragments while leaving the ground-state MP2 energy unchanged. With appropriately calibrated parameters, these shifts improve overall accuracy and substantially accelerate convergence without increasing the formal scaling of the amplitude solve. Different optimal parameters for valence and Rydberg states reveal the limitations of a common parameter. The analysis further shows that shifting the contracted-triples block contributes markedly to the excitation-energy correction in addition to accelerating convergence.

AI.tldr: 该文阐明CIS(2)微扰理论与CIS(D)的理论联系，系统评估其激发能精度，并开发尺寸强化（size-intensive）能级移动以同时提升精度与振幅方程收敛性。
AI.motivation: CIS(2)是作者此前提出的基于CIS态的二阶微扰理论，但其与既有方法（如CIS(D)）的理论关系不清，激发能精度缺乏系统评估，且振幅方程收敛性与精度有待改进。
AI.method: 推导CIS(2)工作方程的MP2结构，证明Hybrid划分在采用基态Fock算符且忽略CIS参考态上剩余Fock作用时退化为CIS(D)；比较CIS态Fock算符与CIS(D)在价态、Rydberg、电荷转移激发上的表现并分析空穴/粒子密度贡献；引入保持非相互作用碎片基态关联能、不改变基态MP2能量的尺寸强化能级移动。
AI.result: CIS态Fock算符相对CIS(D)改善了Rydberg、尤其电荷转移精度，但略降低价态精度；校准参数后的能级移动提升总体精度并显著加速收敛且不增加形式标度；价态与Rydberg最优参数不同，说明单一参数的局限；移动收缩三体块除加速收敛外还显著贡献激发能修正。
AI.conclusion: CIS(2)与CIS(D)存在明确的理论联系，其中Hybrid划分给出统一视角；尺寸强化能级移动是兼顾精度与收敛性的有效手段，但不同激发类型需区别对待参数。

title: A Density-Matrix Formulation of Vibrational Circular Dichroism Spectra for Møller-Plesset and Configuration Interaction Methods
summary: We reformulate the overlap of wave-function derivatives that defines the atomic axial tensors (AATs) and velocity-gauge atomic polar tensors (VG-APTs) used to compute vibrational circular dichroism (VCD) rotatory strengths. In place of our earlier determinant-level derivatives, the new approach expresses these tensors as contractions involving molecular-orbital derivative integrals, perturbed and unperturbed one- and two-electron density matrices, and dot products of the perturbed correlated wave-function amplitudes. Following the elegant treatment of the diagonal Born-Oppenheimer correction by Gauss and co-workers, the formulation holds for any real, normalized CI-like wave function. The two-electron density contribution vanishes exactly, because one perturbation is real (nuclear) and the other imaginary (magnetic field or momentum); this removes multiple terms from our earlier AAT and VG-APT expressions for second-order Møller-Plesset perturbation theory (MP2) and configuration interaction singles and doubles (CISD). We also present a simplified form of the origin-independent length-gauge [LG(OI)] rotatory strength that avoids the singular-value decomposition of the outer product of the length-gauge APT and VG-APT vectors for each mode, and that clarifies how the LG(OI) and velocity-gauge rotatory strengths are related. Applying the density-based AATs and VG-APTs to ($P$)-hydrogen peroxide, (\textit{S})-methyloxirane, and (\textit{S})-3-chloro-1-butyne, we find that discrepancies among the gauges arise chiefly from basis-set incompleteness in the VG-APT. The charge-sum rule serves as a useful measure of that incompleteness, independent of the correlation method.

AI.tldr: 将VCD的原子轴向张量与速度规范原子极化张量重新表述为密度矩阵收缩形式，任意实归一化CI型波函数均适用，二电子项严格为零，并给出简化LG(OI)转动强度表达式。
AI.motivation: 此前的行列式级导数公式繁琐且对MP2、CISD需保留多个项；同时LG(OI)转动强度需对每个模式的向量外积作奇异值分解，不便使用且难以看清与速度规范的关系。
AI.method: 仿照Gauss等人的对角Born-Oppenheimer修正处理，把波函数导数重叠改写为轨道导数积分、扰动与非扰动一/二电子密度矩阵、以及扰动相关波函数振幅点积的收缩；利用一个扰动为实(核)、另一个为虚(磁场或动量)使二电子密度贡献严格消失；并推导避免奇异值分解的简化LG(OI)形式。
AI.result: 得到适用于任意实归一化CI型波函数的AAT与VG-APT密度表达式，删去MP2、CISD旧式中的多项；对(P)-过氧化氢、(S)-甲基环氧乙烷和(S)-3-氯-1-丁炔计算表明，规范间差异主要源于VG-APT的基组不完备，电荷和规则可作为与相关方法无关的不完备性度量。
AI.conclusion: 基于密度的AAT/VG-APT公式更简洁普适，简化LG(OI)表达式阐明了与速度规范转动强度的联系；实际计算中规范差异主要归因于基组不完备而非相关方法。

title: Lanthanide Crystal Field Theory in the J-Mixing Regime: $f^n$ Configurations
